english_samples: Nogeloix of Frondale's Phrontistery has shared with you some of the basic teachings of the alchemical trade. Within the halls of the Phrontistery are patients suffering from a variety of ailments, and the alchemists busy themselves with their treatment and the development of new medicines. He also tells you of the affliction of the guildmaster's son, Damielliot, who has slipped into unconsciousness. Making his care the guild's top priority, Nogeloix has asked you to travel to Camp Black Brush to procure curative reagents from a merchant named Nomomo.; You were able to obtain [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000076,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000076,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] from Nomomo. Use it together with [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,3020401,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,3020401,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to create [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000077,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000077,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].; You have successfully concocted [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000077,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000077,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Return with it to Frondale's Phrontistery and deliver it to Nogeloix.; Nogeloix has directed you to take [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000077,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000077,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] directly to Damielliot's sickroom, hoping that your presence may evoke some physical response. Seek out Healer S'lyhhia and take the corridor to the ward where Damielliot's room is located.

quest_name: The Boy and the Dragon Gay
english_samples: Given the previous effect your presence seemed to have on Damielliot, Nogeloix has asked you to once again visit the guildmaster's son in his sickroom. Head to Frondale's Phrontistery to see young Damielliot.; You attempt to speak to Damielliot, only to be answered with feverish and dreamy murmurs of dragons. See if the children around you can make any sense of these near-death ramblings.; The children seem to believe that Damielliot must be dreaming of dragons. They claim he was in the midst of telling them a faerie tale involving a dragon just before he took ill. Report what you have learned to Nogeloix.; Nogeloix has charged you with the task of traveling to Gridania to purchase a curative herb that may work to alleviate Damielliot's symptoms. The Phrontistery will even cover the cost of any of the reagent you are able to find. Travel north to Gridania─the Adventurers' Guild there may be an ideal place to learn more...

Healer S'lyhhia has expressed the Phrontistery's desire for the children not to bear witness to the next phase of Damielliot's treatment. Given your rapport with the young ones, she asks that you come and aid in dealing with them. Travel to the Phrontistery and visit Damielliot's sickroom.; Mumbling frantically in the midst of what appears to be a nightmare, you use the Echo to gaze into Damielliot's past. Where is this strange place it has brought you? Is there not a single soul to be found here?; You find Damielliot, injured grievously from a fall and unable to move. You must do what you can to help him.; Damielliot has given you [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000078,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000078,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] together with an alchemical recipe. Use them to create a salve with powerful restorative properties.

Nonolato has described to you the duties of the Archers' Guild, which entail battling against outside evils, such as the Ixal and Garleans, that devise to steal into the Twelveswood. The Gridanian war against the Ixal in particular has been waged for many years─generations, even. As a [@IF($E9(4),woman,man)] of the Gods' Quiver, you first require a partner. Seek out Keelty, to whom you have been paired.; Keelty tells you of a report from the leatherworkers at Atelier Fen[@1F]Yll expressing concern over the rising number of Ixal hunting animals in the Twelveswood. If this trend continues, it stands to threaten the stability of the leather trade. You and Keelty are to patrol the wood for any Ixali huntsmen. Make whatever preparations you must and travel to Camp Emerald Moss to meet your partner.; After meeting Keelty at Camp Emerald Moss, she informs you that the two of you will be splitting up to cover more ground on your ranging. Patrol the area around Fallgourd Lake, and keep a sharp eye out for any Ixal.; You come across a lone Ixal battling a horde of yarzons. Sensing itself overmatched, it seizes upon the opportunity of your arrival to escape, leaving the agitated yarzons to turn on you... You have no choice but to fight.

Nonolato has explained that the threats the Twelveswood faces are not limited to the Ixal and Garleans. Taking steps to rediscover the peace and tranquility of the forest, he has ordered you to deliver a letter to the Knights of Ishgard. Seek out Keelty and speak to her first.; Telling Keelty of the task entrusted to you, she tells you to meet her at Owl's Nest, claiming the injuries she suffered on your last ranging will only serve to slow you. Make whatever preparations you must and set out for the Ishgardian hamlet in the Coerthas region.; You arrive at Owl's Nest to find a number of knights have been dispatched to the hamlet. Has Keelty not yet arrived? See to your task, and seek out a high-ranking knight to whom the message you bear can be delivered.; You deliver the message from Nonolato to Ser Vairemont. Upon reading its contents, he immediately gives the order for the Knights of Ishgard to set out for the Black Shroud. What tidings could the letter have contained...? Speak to Keelty, who has arrived at long last.

Nonolato is worried that Keelty has not yet reported back to the Quiver's Hold. He confides in you that many among the archers believe her numerous injuries to be evidence that someone or something is hunting her. He has asked that as her partner, you search for her and lend whatever aid you can. Speak to the other archers to see if any have chanced to see Keelty or know where she might have gone.; You are able to track down Keelty in the vicinity of Sorrel Haven. As Nonolato suspected, she is being chased by something in the forest which seeks to take her life. She orders you to escape back to Gridania and not to speak of what you have seen. What is a partner to do...?; While fleeing back to Gridania, you come upon a pack of feral beasts. You manage to make your way past them, but did Keelty escape safely from her unnamed assassin? Return to see if your partner is out of danger.; You come upon Keelty, cornered by her pursuer. Come to your partner's aid and defeat her would-be assassin.

After convincing Bodenolf to accept you into the guild, he suggested that you speak with veteran forgehand Mimidoa and have him instruct you on the basics of metallurgy.; A queer conversation with the tiny forgehand leads to Mimidoa asking you to create him [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000004,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000004,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] using two [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10002011,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10002011,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Procure the ingredients and follow the recipe provided to test your mettle.; A queer conversation with the tiny forgehand leads to Mimidoa asking you to create him [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000008,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000008,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] using [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10002021,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10002021,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10002071,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10002071,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Procure the ingredients and follow the recipe provided to test your mettle.; You have successfully crafted the item requested by Mimidoa. Take it to the master blacksmith for inspection.

According to Bodenolf, Mimidoa has requested you to assist him on another project having to do with matters most suspicious. Speak with the senior smith to learn how you can help.; However, upon entering the caverns, you notice some of the miners have begun to act frantic. Play the parley tiles with the injured to keep their spirits up until they can all be rescued.; Rumors of mythical beasts known as sirens in the waters of Limsa Lominsa have the city[@1F]state's sailors refusing to leave port for fear that they may fall victim to the seductresses' song. To create [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000022,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000022,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] capable of nullifying the effects of the malefic melodies, Mimidoa requires you to travel to Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern in Ul'dah and pick up a crate of special ore.; Linette has refused to sell you the items requested by Mimidoa. Contact the smithy via the Naldiq & Vymelli's linkpearl for further instructions.

Limsa Lominsa's siren crisis has cooled, but tempers at Naldiq & Vymelli's have grown hotter than the flames in their forges. A battle is brewing over which half of the guild, the blacksmiths or the armorers, has the right to use the remaining supplies of ore, with the blacksmiths claiming they require it to complete a colossal order from the Knights of the Barracuda for a shipment of cannons. Speak with Mimidoa to learn his thoughts on the situation.; After hearing that the Knights of the Barracuda are ordering cannons for the sole purpose of leveling the island of the sirens, Mimidoa insists that you help him deal with the vixens before the Knights can carry out their plans. Your first assignment is to create [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000050,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000050,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], which can be synthesized using [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000052,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000052,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and two [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10002011,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10002011,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].; After hearing that the Knights of the Barracuda are ordering cannons for the sole purpose of leveling the island of the sirens, Mimidoa insists that you help him deal with the vixens before the Knights can carry out their plans. Your first assignment is to create [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000051,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000051,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], which can be synthesized using [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000053,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000053,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10002021,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10002021,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].; Present the completed [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000050,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000050,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to Mimidoa for inspection.

Soileine has shared with you the core of a conjurer's duties─to quiet the mind and heart until you can hear the faint whispers of the elementals, to protect them, and to act as intermediaries between them and the people of Gridania. To begin your way down the path of conjury, seek out Brother Telent.; You have made the acquaintance of the jovial Brother Telent, a wizened old cynic who hears the voices of the arbor elementals. Those residing within a tree recently brought to the Oak Atrium have told him of a pack of rabid coywolves wreaking havoc in the wood. Do as the elementals ask, and head east into the forest by way of Blue Badger Gate until you come upon a clearing of dead trees.; You have defeated a number of the wild coywolves in the forest. After doing so, a mysterious Midlander appears who seems to be a conjurer. He claims that the elementals say you have killed enough of the feral beasts. Return to Stillglade Fane and report back to Brother Telent.; You tell Brother Telent of all that transpired in the wood. He confesses to you that the taking of life within the Twelveswood, even that of beasts as vicious as rabid coywolves, invites the greenwrath of the elementals. When the greenwrath becomes too great, one is cursed and becomes a wildling─taken by the wood and damned to wander it for all time. He also informs you that the Midlander you came upon is a mysterious conjurer named Morys, but that is all. See Soileine to collect your reward.

Soileine has spoken to you of ancient trees in the forest within which the most powerful of elementals reside. When these trees come to harm and the fury of the elementals is wakened, great tragedy follows. It is for this reason that a magical barrier known as the Hedge has been raised to protect them. But the Hedge alone cannot guard the entire forest. You have been ordered to travel to Lifemend Stump, and together with Brother Morys patrol the Twelveswood.; You were able to find Brother Morys near Lifemend Stump, but he left suddenly, claiming that the wood was calling to him. Where could he have gone? Contact Soileine with your linkpearl and see if she might have some clue as to where Morys has gone.; Following Soileine's directions, you find Brother Morys again near Amberscale Rock. But he was not alone... Fearsome elementals hover before you, but what could have happened to anger them so? Your hand is forced... You have no recourse but to defeat them.; After defeating the enraged elementals, you discover an Elezen knight, near death and lying on the forest floor. You must contact someone immediately if you hope to save him.

The next phase of your training in conjury will focus upon the difficult task of hearing the elementals. Soileine reassures you that not all are capable of achieving this goal, and many conjurers die without ever having heard the forest's whispers. But to become a [@1A(1)]true[@1A(0)] master of conjury... Speak to Brother Ingram to learn more of your task.; Brother Ingram confesses that he is no admirer of adventurers and their fickle ways. Yet the elementals have beckoned so many to the forest that he cannot ignore that they have some part to play. He teaches you of the mentality that must be tempered in order to hear the forest's whispers. You must [@1A(1)]know[@1A(0)], with every fiber of your being, that it is the elementals which sustain life in all creation. Take the [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000101,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000101,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you are given and travel into the Twelveswood. There was a place where you once thought to have heard the voices of the elementals...; Upon arriving at Amberscale Rock, Brother Morys appears claiming to have been guided there by some voice. He asks that you travel north with him to the lands of Ishgard, and says he will await you at Camp Emerald Moss. Rendezvous with him after you have prepared for the journey.; You set out for Ishgard together with Brother Morys, but when you attempt to leave the Twelveswood a mysterious voice resounds through the air, and in a flash of light he vanishes from your side. Could the voice have been that of an elemental? Search for Brother Morys to make certain he is safe.

The Culinarians' Guild has accepted you into their ranks, allowing you the opportunity to learn the secrets of fine cuisine under the tutelage of the realm's best and brightest of chefs. Your first insructors are to be the pair of Pulmia and Prudentia.; Thanks to your assistance, and despite Prudentia's quicker finish, the very next order placed comes with specific orders that it be made by Pulmia. Prudentia seems shocked with the outcome of their friendly competition and leaves the restaurant out the rear exit. Perhaps you should speak with Prudentia in an attempt to lift her spirits.; Rivals Prudentia and Pulmia have been given the challenge of preparing thirty orders, each of them confident that she will best the other. Who will prove the victor? Speak with both to find out.; Prudentia has asked for your help in defeating Pulmia in their kitchen battle. Use the recipe provided by her to create one [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000069,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000069,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], tout de suite. quest_name: Mystery of the Gastronome Gone Home
english_samples: According to Charlys, Prudentia is (once again) low in spirits, and (once again) it seems to concern her cooking. Find the crestfallen culinarian and listen to her sad, sad tale.; You find Prudentia sulking over her work in the restaurant. It seems the cause of her woes stems from the sudden disappearance of one of her customers. Report what you learned to Charlys and see if he has any advice on what to do next.; Charlys believes the customer in question is none other than a merchant hailing from the Weavers' Guild of Ul'dah, and suggests that you travel to Sunsilk Tapestries and learn why he stopped frequenting the restaurant.; You learn of the merchant's whereabouts from Sunsilk Tapestries receptionist Deaustie. Now speak with the Lalafellin trader to see if you cannot solve the mystery.

While speaking with Prudentia, Pulmia's suitor enters the kitchens in search of his love. Upon seeing this, however, Prudentia's mood suddenly sours. Perhaps a quick foray into Prudentia's past via the Echo will help shed some light on the situation.; A peek into Prudentia's past reveals that a handsome young man named Lienart might have something to do with the chef's current feelings. When you try asking her about him, however, she simply tells you that she would like to be alone.; As suddenly and as violently as a summer squall, Prudentia storms out of the Bismarck. After a word with Charlys, you learn that this may be due to the fact Prudentia's fiancé dropped in the restaurant earlier. Her [@1A(1)]former[@1A(0)] fiancé.[@CR] As always, Charlys asks you to find the woebegone chef and cheer her up. He believes she may be somewhere in the city with a clear view of the bay.; You find Prudentia at a place sailors call the “bethel”─a shrine to the Navigator overlooking Galadion Bay. There, she tells you, is where she first met the love of her life...but is unwilling to divulge any more. Luckily, the gods have granted you with the gift of the Echo.

You've earned a place in the Executioners─an influential pirate crew in Limsa Lominsa─but you will be starting at the bottom of the bottom, and will have to work your way up if you want to earn any respect amongst your bandit brethren. Waekbyrt has pointed you in the general direction of one Nunuba to learn what you can do to ensure your new captain succeeds in claiming the Admiral's chair.; Nunuba gives you a...colorful...explanation of the Trident─a winner-takes-all race used to determine Limsa Lominsa's Admiral. Your part in the festivities involves traveling to Swiftperch Tower near the hamlet of Aleport and culling a few lemmings.; You were able to eliminate all the lemmings infesting the tower. Return to the Astalicia with the tails and report to Waekbyrt and Nunuba.

While chatting away with Waekbyrt below decks on the Astalicia, Rhoswen of the Sanguine Sirens and Carvallain of the Kraken's Arms enter and begin another of their heated debates─this time over who is best suited to be [@1A(1)]your[@1A(0)] new captain. It is in this awkward manner you learn of your immediate dismissal from the Bloody Executioners. Perhaps the scurvy dogs in the lounge can lift your spirits.; The scurviest of dogs in the lounge─a self-proclaimed pirate named Rostnsthal─has offered you a position as first mate in his shipless crew of one. After accepting (and making it a crew of two), your captain gives you your first assignment─to help him “procure” funds to rebuild a damaged ship he claims to have in dry dock. And to do this, he has suggested you break into the Kraken's Arms' lair and steal some of their loot!; You are able to collect several items of value from the Krakens' den. Return to the Astalicia and give them to Rostnsthal.; After patting you on the head for a job well done, Rostnsthal informs you of the second part of your mission. To prevent the Kraken's Arms from tracing the theft back to you and your captain, you are to take the stolen items to a merchant Rostnsthal knows in Ul'dah. Look for him on Sapphire Avenue.

Waekbyrt has ordered you to pay a visit to the Astalicia captain. According to the pirate, not only is he the leader of the Bloody Executioners and founder of the Marauders' Guild, but also the most respected [@1A(1)]and[@1A(0)] most feared pirate in all of Limsa Lominsa.; Upon arriving at the captain's quarters, you are “greeted” by several imposing-looking grunts. When the grunts introduce you as Rostnsthal's first mate to an even [@1A(1)]more[@1A(0)] imposing-looking pirate standing ominously in the back of the room, the man grows irritated and barks a command to the men to do with you as they will. This does not seem like a fight you can win...; After losing consciousness, you wake up to find yourself in a dark room. Try seeing if you cannot find any clue as to where you've been stowed.; Upon checking a rum barrel, you find none other than your captain, Rostnsthal, squatting inside, the original contents of the wooden hogshead already consumed─presumably by the besotted man swaying precariously before you. He tells you in his slurred speech that you are in a warehouse of some shady maritime trading company, and that he's here to find an item of value...for reasons you cannot discern. For now, return to the Astalicia and wait for your captain's next orders.

After accepting N'nmulika's invitation to join the Fishermen's Guild, you are asked to take your first step to becoming a full-fledged puller by assisting fellow fisher Maisie with her work. She can be found somewhere in the Bottom.; According to Maisie, the Knights of the Barracuda, as well as many of Limsa Lominsa's pirate crews, are waging a never-ending battle with the beast tribe known as the Sahagin. Wawalago's Pullers play their part by catching [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000127,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000127,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], which are used by the Knights and the pirates to lure the Sahagin from their lairs. Maisie has asked you to travel to the cliffs along lowland La Noscea and see if you cannot fetch some for her.; You've caught several [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000127,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000127,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Return them to Maisie in Fisherman's Bottom before they go bad.

N'nmulika has asked you to assist Sisipu in her guild duties. Find the tiny puller and see what she needs you to do.; It turns out that Sisipu is in charge of feeding the fish being raised in the man-made ponds known as the Barrel, and for today, that duty has been passed to you. Take your bucket of special bait and speak with Rerenasu down by the docks for a ride to the Barrel.; While diligently distributing fish fodder, you are approached by a mysterious mustachioed man who insists that the fish require more than just food, but exercise as well─exercise in the form of dancing. The task of setting an example on just how the fish are supposed to dance has unfortunately fallen to you.; The mysterious man seems pleased with your performance, but now insists that you lack a certain something to make the fish swoon─a certain something that you can find in Ul'dah. A man named Rorojaru should be able to help.

N'nmulika claims that you have been given a chance to express your outrage at the humiliation you suffered at the Barrel. Visit Fisherman's Bottom for further details.; A gaggle of aggravated pullers has gathered around Netmaster Wawalago to articulate their aggrievances towards their lewdest of leaders. It looks like the end for the Lalafell, when out of nowhere he offers to hold a sale to end all sales. Speak with N'nmulika for instructions on how you can participate.; N'nmulika has told you the type of catch the guild is looking for. Bring one back before Fisherman's Bottom puts a moratorium on purchases!; And just as suddenly as it started, the sale of the century has come to a close. You soon learn, however, that [@1A(1)]some[@1A(0)] pullers have been granted an extension by the netmaster. Find Wawalago and see if you, too, cannot convince him to give you more time to trawl.

Lulutsu of the Coliseum has delivered a riveting account of the excitement and thrill of the gladiatorial games held on the bloodsands. The selections for the upcoming tourney are already underway, and your aid has been requested in weeding out the weak from the lists. Prepare yourself for battle and head for the Coliseum.; Arriving at the Coliseum, you find your challenger waiting. Finish him!; You have bested your first opponent on the bloodsands in true gladiatorial fashion. Return to Lulutsu and report the deed done.

Lulutsu has shared with you management's concerns over finding gifted new fighters for the Coliseum in order to keep crowds excited. Travel north to Gridania to scout such talent, and there join forces with another of the Coliseum who has gone ahead of you.; While asking around at Carline Canopy, you come across the Coliseum's Yoyobina, who tells you of a former champion of the bloodsands who has since joined the ranks of the Wood Wailers. Visit the Wailing Barracks to find out more and pray things do not turn violent.; Perceiving the gladiatorial games as an affront to a noble cause such as their own, the Wood Wailers welcome you to their guild with a “friendly” duel. Your opponent seems all too eager to get the contest underway... Defeat the lancer J'moldva.; You have prevailed in your duel against the Wood Wailer J'moldva. But just who is this past champion of the Coliseum you have come seeking? Perhaps the echoes of J'moldva's past might reveal more...

Lulutsu of the Coliseum has contacted you with news of an opportunity to fight on the bloodsands as a gladiator. Seek out Yoyobina to hear more.; Yoyobina details for you the upcoming tourney of warriors. Learn what you can from other gladiators around the Coliseum and prepare yourself for battle before speaking to Yoyobina again.; The Coliseum's tourney of warriors is underway, and your time on the bloodsands has come. Give the crowds what they want, and fell your opponent with great fanfare!; You gave the crowds reason to cheer and were triumphant in your battle on the bloodsands. While Yoyobina praises your performance, a familiar-looking Lalafell appears. Before approaching him, speak to Yoyobina again. Perhaps he will be able to help you remember who this little fellow is.

Elecotte of the Goldsmiths' Guild has opened your eyes to the importance of jewelry and fine accessories in Ul'dahn culture. The guild is eager to have you try your hand at the trade to see if you may prove of some worth to Eshtaime's Lapidaries. Begin your training by speaking to Colbernoux.; Colbernoux has asked you to request crafting materials from a Miqo'te miner by the name of Z'ssapa. Seek her out near the entrance to the Nanawa Mines, and be sure to mention Colbernoux's name to lower the price as much as possible.; After hearing Colbernoux's name, Z'ssapa presented you with [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000121,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000121,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Perhaps the clout and favor of the goldsmiths he spoke of was no exaggeration... Return to Eshtaime's Lapidaries with [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000121,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000121,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and speak to Colbernoux.; Colbernoux has taught you of the goldsmithing tradition of designing and naming fine pieces of jewelry after the most beautiful and influential ladies in Ul'dah's illustrious history. As part of your training, use [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000121,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000121,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] given to you by Z'ssapa to create a brooch in her image. Ask some of the other goldsmiths how to best find your muse.

Elecotte has told you about the famous brooch known as F'lhaminn's Flower, an immensely popular trinket created by Colbernoux, which the guild is seeking to reproduce and sell in limited numbers. A required component for its crafting, however, is fresh flowers, which can only be obtained in the Black Shroud. Visit the botanists at Gridania's Greatloam Growery and procure ten [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000123,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000123,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].; Opyltyl of the Greatloam Growery bluntly informs you that the botanists no longer have any desire to deal with Eshtaime's Lapidaries, and the conjurer Rychyld has admonished the goldsmiths' practice of imprisoning elementals behind the glass and metal of their wares. You have also learned that Colbernoux himself is now in Gridania as well, though not as clandestinely as he would hope... Seek him out at the Roost.; After finding Colbernoux at the Roost, he confesses he has come to Gridania seeking a single blossom to craft one last F'lhaminn's Flower. He has requested your aid, and asked that you use [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000114,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000114,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to coax a spriggan into showing you where the blossoms grow. Prepare yourself for whatever perils you may encounter in the wood, and set out for Camp Tranquil.; You have left Camp Tranquil in search of the flower Colbernoux requires. But the way is fraught with dangerous beasts. Perhaps giving [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000114,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000114,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to the spriggan will invigorate and energize it... Colbernoux was kind enough to inform you that [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000114,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000114,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] can be created by combining two [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000115,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000115,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].

Elecotte informs you that an ornate blade known as Heartstrike was the recent target of an attempted theft. To protect the legendary dagger, Lord Lolorito, owner of the Eshtaime franchise, has ordered a number of replicas to be made. Head to the guild storehouses to gather the materials required to craft the false daggers.; Parley with Sence, keeper of the guild storehouse, to obtain the permission you need to gather materials.; You were able to convince Sence to grant you access to the storehouses. Speak to her once again, then obtain the materials you require for your synthesis and show them to her for approval.; You have obtained all the materials you will need from the guild's storehouse. Use them to craft a false Heartstrike, and deliver the finished product to Elecotte.

Opyltyl has spoken to you of the botanists and the role their guild plays in Gridania. They toil to preserve the balance and health of the forest by removing death and decay and trimming back overgrowth. Through their deeds, they also serve the interests of the moogles and conjurers. For your first endeavor, you have been ordered to pay your respects to the forest's elementals. Seek out the botanist Cicely, and have her guide you.; Troublesome weeds have been growing near Quarrymill, choking the pathways used by the conjurers. The elementals have given their consent to see the grasses cut, and so an official request has been submitted to the Greatloam Growery. Cicely has marked the area in question on your map, and told you to go without her.; Cicely arrived at Quarrymill just as you dutifully finished clearing the last of the troublesome weeds. She stays only long enough to speak ill of the drudgery and boredom that is life in Gridania before leaving. Afterwards, a moogle confesses to you that Cicely is an extremely talented gardener. Having met a moogle is surely akin to paying your respects to the elementals. Return to the Greatloam Growery and speak to Opyltyl.

You have learned that Gridania uses an oil procured from plants to power the lights used throughout the city. The present fuel source is less than ideal, however, and the botanists are collaborating with the alchemists of Ul'dah to discover a plant capable of producing a more potent oil. Opyltyl has asked you to deliver a batch of plants to Frondale's Phrontistery. Speak to Cicely to obtain the specimens.; Cicely has complained to you again at great lengths of her dislike for life in Gridania. She has a friend in Ul'dah with whom she corresponds by letter, but claims life in the forest is so boring she has nothing with which to fill a page. She demands that you visit a traveling bard who is putting in at the Carline Canopy, and hear some interesting tale from either Ishgard or Limsa Lominsa.; You are able to find the bard Penelope at the Carline Canopy, who claims to be suffering from a lack of clarity. She has spun so many tales and sung so many songs that it is all a blur in her head. She has agreed to give you your tale if you are able to bring her something to help sort the chaos of her thoughts. Speak with Cicely to see if she has such a something.; Cicely believes she may have exactly the sort of thing the bard Penelope is looking for. However, she is by no means desirous of parting with it. She offers to lend it to you in exchange for [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000086,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000086,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000087,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000087,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Gather the items she wants and bring them back to her.

Word has reached Opyltyl of an attack on moogles in the forest. Sister Rychyld of the conjurers, who communes with the elementals of the trees on behalf of Greatloam Growery, is looking into the matter and has requested the aid of the Botanists' Guild. Speak with her and offer whatever assistance you can.; Sister Rychyld greets you, revealing that she has already heard a great deal about you from Cicely. She invites you to meet her near the flower fields to the south of Camp Crimson Bark. Use your map to travel there and find her.; Sister Rychyld is already waiting for you when you arrive at the flower fields. She tells you that you must collect a number of pearl clover seeds. Bring them to her when you are finished. Not too many, but not too few...; After gathering the pearl clover seeds, Sister Rychyld instructs you to return to the Greatloam Growery. Speak with Cicely once you arrive.

At the Wailing Barracks, the callous Willelda has imparted to you words of whom the Wood Wailers are and what their charge is. The lancers carry out tasks at the behest of Gridania's commonfolk, and patrol the Twelveswood to maintain the peace and expel intruders. If you wish to join their ranks, you too must serve in the name of Gridania and the wood. Go and speak to J'moldva within for your first orders.; J'moldva has briefed you on a request from the botanists at the Greatloam Growery concerning a pest problem. Evidently, among the Wailers' tasks there are even those which unavoidably anger the elementals... To avoid the greenwrath in such cases, the ritual masks are used to divert the wood's fury, but such masks are far too valuable to lend out to a newly joined adventurer. Prepare yourself for a fight, and follow the instructions J'moldva has given you.; You have defeated the orchard chigoes plaguing the area around Lifemend Stump. But while returning to the city you were confronted by a hostile elemental. Luckily, a moogle came along to save you, but what could you have done to so anger this elemental? Return to the Wailing Barracks and report to J'moldva.; You have taken word of your completed task to J'moldva. Your efforts will greatly improve the harvest yields of the Greatloam Growery, and the food stocks of Gridania, as well. Speak to Willelda to receive your reward.

J'moldva has entrusted you with your next assignment as a Wood Wailer. You are to travel to Ul'dah to forge an alliance, as Gridania stands no hope of opposing the Garlean Empire alone. J'moldva believes your best chances of finding a contact lie at the Platinum Mirage. It is known that many Ala Mhigan refugees are employed there, some of whom will likely be sympathetic to your cause. Travel south to the Platinum Mirage of Ul'dah, and do whatever you must to find an ally.; Gagaruna of the Platinum Mirage expresses the Ul'dahns' concern for Gridania's inability to manage its domestic threats. Word reaches them from the north of merchants and travelers who disappear in the wood never to be heard from again. The negative impact on tourism and trade is undeniable, whether the tales themselves are true or not. He has given you leave to ask about the guild for the aid you seek, but how will your request be received?; Seeking no more than words with the quick-tempered Ala Mhigan Dreues, your dialogue results in a physical confrontation. But the fight was simply the man's way of testing your worth, and he takes an immediate liking to you. He promises to take word of your plight to the guild's elite. Return to Gridania and report to J'moldva of your new ally in Ul'dah.; J'moldva is pleased by the results of your journey to the Platinum Mirage, and seems confident that the initial steps to forging an alliance between Ul'dah and Gridania have been taken. No sooner have your efforts been praised than word reaches the guild of a caravan of merchants in distress in the wood. J'moldva orders you to travel along the main road south and find them, and prepare yourself for whatever dangers you might face.

Willelda bluntly asks whether or not you are willing to give your life in service of the wood. You feel as though this might be the preface to a very significant task... Speak to J'moldva and learn what the guild asks of you.; J'moldva has offered you two reports of goings-on at the Wailing Barracks. The good news is that the merchants you saw safely to town have concluded their business and will take word of Gridania's good faith back south with them. This is offset by the bad news─that your efforts to forge an alliance with Ul'dah at the Platinum Mirage have ended in failure. Immediately after hearing this, word reaches the guild of Garlean spies who have infiltrated the Twelveswood. You have been ordered to find the merchant caravan once again on its return journey south, and ensure that they remain safe from the forest's wrath while the interlopers are dealt with.; You find the Ul'dahn merchant caravan facing off against an enraged elemental. What could they have done to waken the greenwrath? Whatever the case, you must save the merchants before all hope of an Ul'dahn alliance is lost.; Upon saving the merchants from the elemental's greenwrath, a moogle promptly appears and chastises you for aiding the outsiders rather than the forest. Use the Echo to view what the merchants did to anger the Twelveswood.

The words of Linette at the Miners' Guild have inspired you to seek your fortune in Eorzea's mineral resources. The wastelands of Ul'dah betray an immense mineral wealth of precious metals and stones below their surface. Head for the Nanawa Mines to see about beginning your mining endeavors.; While speaking to Z'ssapa at the entrance to the Nanawa Mines, the twin heirs apparent to Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern, Popokkuli and Seserukka, come and require that you prove your worth to gain entry. They have directed you to bring whatever you happen to find to Z'ssapa for inspection. Speak to her to find out more.; Prospect in and around eastern, western, and central Thanalan to find what valuables you might, and bring them to Z'ssapa for appraisal.; While searching in Thanalan, you discover an ancient ceramic shard, which a Lalafell named Nenekko tells you comes from an ancient city called Sil'dih. Speak to Nenekko further and learn if the shard will prove enough to win the favor of the flexing Lalafell twins. If you have lost track of her, perhaps Z'ssapa could prove to be of some assistance.

Linette informs you that Popokkuli and Seserukka have assembled a group of adventurers and set out for Gridania. She advises that you travel north with all haste to catch up with them before your absence is noted, or else you will invite the twins' wrath.; You finally track down Popokkuli and Seserukka at the Roost in Gridania as they are attempting to learn where it is Fafajon has headed. Visit the chocobo stables and speak to the talkative coachman to learn what you can.; You have located the coachman who seems to have the information you require. Parley with him to loosen his tongue.; You have coaxed the information you require from the coachman. Contact the twins via linkpearl and tell them what you have learned.

Linette informs you that Nenekko has gone missing, and that her brothers Popokkuli and Seserukka are tearing the city apart piece by piece in their search for her. Heed Linette's advice, and visit the Quicksand to see if Momodi has any helpful information.; To your surprise, you encounter Nenekko at the Quicksand while speaking to Momodi. Troubled, confused, and unsure of right from wrong, she has run away from home in her desperation. She begs for you to take her along with you on your travels, but is she lucid...or raving mad? She flees as her brothers draw near. Find her and hear everything she has to say.; You find Nenekko at the place where the mirage of the Sil'dihn ruins can be seen. She proceeds to get quite philosophical, likening the fading memory of Sil'dih to her own existential dilemma, before asking you to see her safely to the ferry docks of Vesper Bay. She says she will wait for you at the border to western Thanalan.; Escort Nenekko west to the ferry docks of Vesper Bay. Use whatever means you must to throw off any pursuers. This might very well require some actual digging...

Gagaruna of the Pugilists' Guild has imparted to you some of what goes on behind the scenes at the Platinum Mirage. He contends that the world of man is comprised entirely of power, love, and money, and the Platinum Mirage relegates its concerns entirely to the last of those three. To learn more of the guild's ways, speak with your first instructor, Titinin.; Titinin has given you your first task─collecting loan payments. You have been given a list of several of the Mirage's debtors whose payment deadlines are drawing near. Visit them in turn and see to it that they pay what is owed. Head first to Eshtaime's Lapidaries to find Esperaunce, the so-called King of Plots.; You locate the King of Plots, Esperaunce, at Eshtaime's Lapidaries, but find that he barely sees fit to recognize you exist. The loan payment is scattered about the shop floor in fallen coins, which he leaves for you to pick up. Swallow your pride and collect whatever gil you can find.; Having pathetically gathered payment from the King of Plots, your list next directs you to visit the Wise Miser. But who could this deep-thinking, gil-pinching person be? Visit Titinin if you require further assistance in tracking this debtor down.

Titinin has charged you with an important task involving the investigation of counterfeit chips at the Platinum Mirage. There seems to be no doubt that the culprits behind the crime are the pirates of Limsa Lominsa. Travel to the Astalicia and seek out the perpetrators.; While speaking to Waekbyrt aboard the Astalicia, a band of pirates from the crew known as the Kraken's Arms appear, led by the extremely intelligent and articulate Elezen, Captain Carvallain. He has offered to aid you in your search, but demands that the Mirage pay a hefty sum of gil for his information. Contact Titinin via linkpearl and tell him of this development.; Titinin has ordered you to head to the Mizzenmast in Limsa Lominsa while he approaches the Mirage's leaders with the information you have given him.; At the Mizzenmast, you come across U'mallibo the pirate and a pugilist newly come to Limsa Lominsa named Hurrey. It becomes clear that your meeting is no coincidence, as the two of them are there at the behest of Titinin. According to U'mallibo, the evidence you require in the counterfeiting case can be found aboard the [@1A(1)]Misery[@1A(0)], the ship of the Kraken's Arms. Make your way to the Sailors Ward beyond the Southern Islands and steal about the ship.

While speaking to Gagaruna, Titinin enters and asks you once again to collect a loan payment from Lady Lewena following another adventurer's failed attempt to do so. Perhaps she can be found again near the Platinum Mirage's main entrance...; At the entrance to the Platinum Mirage, you find Hurrey and Lady Lewena's handmaiden, both of whom seem concerned over the lady's ability to make her loan payment. Use the Echo to discover where Lady Lewena might be.; Through the Echo, you witnessed a scene in which Hurrey was serving as an escort to Lady Lewena. She mentioned traveling to the Silver Bazaar, to a certain plateau. But which one? Travel to the Silver Bazaar and search for Lady Lewena.; You discover Lady Lewena at one of the plateaus near the Silver Bazaar. With her are a number of pugilists protecting her, fighting against a thaumaturge of Arrzaneth Ossuary. Come to Lady Lewena's aid and see to it she does not come to harm.

Hereward has offered you a rudimentary explanation of leatherworking, and the respect for the elementals it entails. There is life within the things crafted by the hands of man, and that life must be cared for. To that end, Atelier Fen[@1F]Yll oversees the management of the Ebony Stalls, a cluster of shops that employ a number of craftsmen and women specializing in repairs. As your first task, you are to visit the Ebony Stalls and offer your services to Lalatta, your new mentor.; You arrive at the Ebony Stalls to find an adorable little Lalafell leatherworker surrounded by a crowd of agitated lancers. What series of events could have led to this distressing sight? Speak to Lalatta after the lancers have gone, and see what business brought them.; Lalatta relates to you how the lancers came and purchased a batch of new leather armor, claiming that they had no time to wait on Lalatta's slow repairs. Despondent, she finds comfort in the words of the nearby merchant Theldry, who convinces her to make the repairs and deliver the armor to the Wood Wailers nonetheless. Aid Lalatta in her effort by seeing to the [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000044,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000044,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] she has entrusted to you. You will require [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10007126,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10007126,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to make the repairs.; You have finished the task at hand, and are now in possession of [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000045,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000045,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Deliver it to Lalatta forthwith.

As part of your continued training, Hereward has explained a bit about the drawbacks of maintaining an immensely popular brand. Recently, mountain brigands have learned the value of Fen[@1F]Yll wares, and merchants and traders bearing the guild's goods are often ambushed on the northern roads, and their cargo stolen. To prevent this, the guild has decided to test a practice of shipping items individually rather than in bulk. Take [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000021,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000021,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] entrusted to you and travel to the hamlet of Owl's Nest in Coerthas.; As you near Owl's Nest, you are suddenly ambushed from behind by a lone bandit. Just as you are to be parted with either your life or your [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000021,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000021,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], or both, Lalatta appears and renders the fiend unconscious with a single blow. Yayake of the Thaumaturges' Guild has taught you about two of the basic pillars of the Order of Nald'thal─virtue and wealth. Virtue accrued in this life determines one's place in the realm of Thal after death. And to win virtue, one must amass and leave behind as much wealth as possible. Speak to the thaumaturge I'llofii to begin your service to Arrzaneth Ossuary.; I'llofii has spoken to you of the third pillar of the Order─sin. She presents to you the last will and testament of a patron of the Ossuary, which contains a vengeance order─a service provided by the thaumaturges whereby revenge is exacted upon who or whatever took the life of the deceased. Execute the vengeance order, and kill the death-marked billygoat responsible for the patron's death.; You have killed the death-marked billygoat and obtained a twisted aldgoat horn as proof of the deed. Return to Arrzaneth Ossuary and report to I'llofii.

Yayake has charged you with the task of traveling to Limsa Lominsa to sell graves and burial plots within the Ossuary to the citizenry there. Speak to the other thaumaturges to learn what you can of peddling graves.; You have made your first rival in the guild, a Lalafellin novice being sent to Ishgard to sell graves in the same manner as you. She departs after boasting of being the better thaumaturge and assuring you she will sell more graves. Make preparations for your journey and set out to the west for Limsa Lominsa.; Deciphering the speech of Baderon, you learn that the smiths of Naldiq & Vymelli's have been known to purchase graves from the Ossuary in the past. But you must first do them some kindness before they are like to hear you out. Baderon shares that he has received word of a smith being attacked just beyond the city moments prior to your arrival. Hurry to the smith's aid in lower La Noscea and save her to ingratiate yourself with her guild.; You were unable to save the smith from the beast which ravaged her. Return to Naldiq & Vymelli's with news of her fate and see if there is a grave to be sold.

Yayake has directed you to aid I'llofii for your next task. A horrific accident has occurred, claiming a number of lives─patrons of the Ossuary among them. Learn what you can of the incident from the thaumaturges at the Ossuary, and then speak to I'llofii to hear what you must do.; I'llofii has told you that a chocobo coach bound for Ul'dah from the ferry docks of Vesper Bay met with a terrible fate, leaving many dead. Some among the deceased have vengeance orders, the validity of which must be discerned by discovering if the accident was truly accidental... Travel to the site of the accident and investigate its cause.; Arriving at the site of the accident, you find your guild rival already on the scene. She claims to be searching for possessions of the deceased to be used in the funerary rites. Use the power of the Echo to see if she is telling all she knows.; The Echo reveals that the Lalafell novice is complicit in murder, having used her thaumaturgy on the coach driver to bring about the accident. Though the Order's law prevents a vengeance order being carried out against one of their own, the novice attacks you to protect her secret. Defeat your rival.

A'naidjaa has enlightened you in the ways of the carpenters of the Oak Atrium. Within the lumber and other materials they work with reside the elementals, and so there is little tolerance for error and waste. Rather than worry, you have been directed outside to the Acorn Orchard, where you will meet your first...instructors.; Your first instructors have turned out to be the younglings in the Oak Atrium's care. In a show of thanks to the Gods' Quiver for keeping Gridania safe, they have been busying themselves crafting new arrows of which they mean to make a gift. They have asked you to deliver the arrows to Quarrymill. Make whatever preparations you must before setting out.; Wybir of the Gods' Quiver happily accepts the younglings' arrows. She would like nothing more than to loose a few at the practice butts, but it seems that her bow has recently suffered a crack and she is terrified of drawing it. Search the area for the most suitable type of wood and repair Wybir's bow for her.; You have gathered a piece of lumber which looks like it will serve your purposes. Make the repairs and then show the bow to Wybir.

A'naidjaa has asked you to watch after the younglings while Marcelloix attends to more pressing affairs. Head through the door at the rear of the Oak Atrium, and visit the children in their workshop.; Sure enough, stuttering Ryd was hiding at the Wailing Barracks. But the game is not over yet... Parley with Ryd to discover what he knows of the other hiding children.; You discover Elyn hiding near the Quiver's Hold. Parley with her to learn whatever she might know. Also, it seems that Nicoliaux may be privy to the hiding spot of the last remaining child─Aunillie.; The younglings have revealed that one of them is likely hiding somewhere near the Wailing Barracks. Find the sprat and end this game!

Travel to Quarrymill, and assist her in any way you can.

As part of your initiation, Deaustie has seen fit to explain the general philosophy of the weavers at Sunsilk Tapestries, the guiding maxims of which are “beauty is everything,” and “truth lies in appearances,” to paraphrase. The weavers strive to costume their custom so that they may adequately play their roles in life. Your first mentor is to be Chuchumu, a Lalafell of low means with a good heart. Find her at the Golden Bazaar.; You arrive at the hamlet known as the Golden Bazaar to find Chuchumu in tears. Having been attacked by a feral beast, her red riding hood, a family heirloom lent her by her stepmother, was torn to shreds. She must have another lest she face her stepmother's wrath. Return to Sunsilk Tapestries and see what can be done.; Having heard of Chuchumu's plight, Deaustie has directed you to help the poor Lalafell. Deaustie passes on tidings of a ball to be put on by the royal family and the Syndicate in the near future. Chuchumu must see to the tailoring of evening gowns for her two wicked stepsisters. However, Lady Ouvielle's place in high society has earned an open invitation for her entire family─including a certain lowly Lalafell stepdaughter! At Deaustie's request, aid Chuchumu in her tasks so that she might have time to prepare for the ball herself.; Chuchumu has told you that she has no hope of attending the ball without first procuring a pair of magic slippers from the green wizard of Gridania. Though it sounds like the stuff of faerie tales, travel north to Gridania and discover what you can about this wizard and his fabled footwear.; Soileine of the Conjurers' Guild at Stillglade Fane has suggested that you make your inquiries at the Ebony Stalls. Make your way there and see if any of the merchants might prove useful.; A merchant named Theldry at the Ebony Stalls has told you that what you seek are none other than the midnight slippers which she herself is selling. Unfortunately, a buyer has already reserved them and Theldry is nothing if not a woman of her word. However, she confides that she may be able to sell you the slippers if you could advertise her shop enough to compensate for slightly sullying her name. Speak to the customers around you and say whatever you must to boost the popularity of Theldry's shop.

The talk all over town is of the royal ball and a beautiful maiden who appeared and captured the crown prince's heart, only to flee the palace at the stroke of midnight, leaving behind a single glove in her haste. Armed with this glove, the prince is scouring the city in search of his beloved. As a result, ladies from all over Ul'dah have placed orders for single gloves in hopes of deceiving the prince. While there is still a profit to be made, Deaustie has asked that you craft ten [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000056,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000056,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].; Chuchumu has informed you that luxurious gloves can only be crafted using Thanalan spider silk. Use each [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000057,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000057,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you obtain together with [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10005015,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10005015,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,10005302,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,10005302,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to synthesize the ten [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000056,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000056,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] requested of you.; Freeing your mentor from the spiderwebs, you obtained the silk you required and were able to craft ten [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000056,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000056,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].
