The problem, however, is that before she was able to present her new creation to the Maelstrom, it was stolen from the restaurant kitchens by one Kikkiroon Irongut. To render the Qiqirn incapable of perpetrating further acts of gastronomic larceny, R'sushmo took the rather drastic step of poisoning a second batch of suncakes, knowing that Kikkiroon would be unable to resist their sweet, lemony allure. Now she wants you to travel to Cedarwood and make sure that her plan was a success...and on the off-chance that it was not, to finish the job.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to two party members may accompany you.; After finding Kikkiroon Irongut very much unaffected by the Nightbreath poison, you proceed to beat the beastman to a bloody pulp when, out of nowhere, a high-ranking official from the Maelstrom happens to wander by. Perhaps you should speak with her before dealing the final blow. No sense rushing justice, after all.; R'sushmo, chef at the world-renowned Bismarck, has developed a new type of ration that not only prevents the scurvy, but also tastes great─suncakes. The problem, however, is that before she was able to present her new creation to the Maelstrom, it was stolen from the restaurant kitchens by one Kikkiroon Irongut. To render the Qiqirn incapable of perpetrating further acts of gastronomic larceny, R'sushmo took the rather drastic step of poisoning a second batch of suncakes, knowing that Kikkiroon would be unable to resist their sweet, lemony allure. Now she wants you to travel to Cedarwood and make sure that her plan was a success.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to two party members may accompany you.

Lilina, assessor at Mealvaan's Gate, believes that kobolds have been stealing shipments of a rare ore called sthalite from trading vessels moored in Galadion Bay. According to sketchy reports from Knights of the Barracuda patrols in upper La Noscea, kobold activity near a system of caverns known as the U'Ghamaro Mines has recently seen a dramatic increase. After putting two and two together, Lilina is now worried that the kobolds may be using the ore in preparation to wage war on Limsa Lominsa. She wants you to travel to the Mines and investigate, but only after first visiting Camp Iron Lake, an outpost in the vicinity.; Upon arriving at Camp Iron Lake, you speak with a Sergeant Nolan of the Maelstrom. He tells you that your mission for Mealvaan's Gate is over, and that you now report to him. After briefing you on sthalite and cobalt iron, he hands you several vials of a strange liquid taken from coblyns and orders you to apply it to metal objects you find within the U'Ghamaro Mines, noting whether or not the fluid turns from yellow to green upon contact.; You have used all the liquid given to you by the Storm Sergeant, but noticed no changes in color. Report back to Camp Iron Lake to relay your findings and receive your reward.; Lilina, assessor at Mealvaan's Gate, believes that kobolds have been stealing shipments of a rare ore called sthalite from trading vessels moored in Galadion Bay. According to sketchy reports from Knights of the Barracuda patrols in upper La Noscea, kobold activity near a system of caverns known as the U'Ghamaro Mines has recently seen a dramatic increase. After putting two and two together, Lilina is now worried that the kobolds may be using the ore in preparation to wage war on Limsa Lominsa. She wants you to travel to the mines and investigate.

To protect their creations from the elements and keep them in good working order, the armorers of Naldiq & Vymelli's require a rare lubricant pressed from the seeds of the deadly nightshade. This virulent vegetation can only be found growing on the shores of Iron Lake in Upper La Noscea, and is renowned amongst botanists for being rather...aggressive. Syngsmyd seems to believe that the oil from [@IF($E5(6,0),[@IF($E2(6,10),[@SWITCH(6,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(6)])],[@VALUE(6)])] will be enough to replenish his supply.; You have extracted the oil from [@IF($E5(6,0),[@IF($E2(6,10),[@SWITCH(6,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(6)])],[@VALUE(6)])] deadly nightshades. Now return to Naldiq & Vymelli's and deliver the lot to Syngsmyd to receive your reward.; To protect their creations from the elements and keep them in good working order, the armorers of Naldiq & Vymelli's require a rare lubricant pressed from the seeds of the deadly nightshade. This virulent vegetation can only be found growing on the shores of Iron Lake in Upper La Noscea, and is renowned amongst botanists for being rather...aggressive.

Lieutenant Guincum has commanded you to travel to upper La Noscea in order to assess Storm Sergeant Second Class Brooks's handling of the Maelstrom assault on a kobold encampment. While on site, you are to provide whatever additional assistance is required to fulfill the mission objectives. The sergeant's unit is situated directly to the east of the beast tribe fortification.; Sergeant Brooks has chosen not to engage the enemy while his captain is injured...effectively ruining any chance the Maelstrom had of effectively implementing its wave assault stratagem. He has given you permission to attempt an attack on your own, but insists that you go alone, for he does not want the fate of a single soul─save yours─on his conscience. Perform well, and the sergeant will send Maelstrom Command a gleaming report detailing your service.[@CR][@CR]※ No party members may accompany you.[@CR]※ Slay kobold cragsmen, roundsmen, and bedesmen at the kobold encampment until you earn 1000 War Merit.[@CR]※ This duty has a time limit of [@VALUE(30)] minutes (Earth time).[@CR]※ All amassed War Merit will be lost should you be KO'd, run out of time, or abandon the duty.; You have weakened the kobold forces enough to ensure the southern unit will not face any difficulty in conducting their assault on the encampment. Return to Sergeant Brooks to report.; The sight of glorious victory dripping from your hands and uniform has caused poor Sergeant Brooks to have a funny turn. Hurry back to Maelstrom Command before he covers you in something smellier and significantly less glorious.

Lieutenant Guincum has commanded you to travel to Mistbeard Cove, northeast of Camp Bald Knoll. Maelstrom patrols in the area have been plagued by the attacks of a rampaging great buffalo, and your duty is to track down and slay the massive beast.[@CR][@CR]※ The great buffalo appears only during daylight hours (Eorzea time).; You have slain the great buffalo and secured the area for future patrols. Return to Maelstrom Command and report your success to Lieutenant Guincum.; Duly impressed with your achievements in the field, Maelstrom Command has seen fit to promote you from petty officer to officer, your new rank being Second Storm Lieutenant. Treat Lieutenant Guincum to your finest Storm Salute as a demonstration of your continued allegiance.[@CR][@CR]※ To perform a Storm Salute, first target Lieutenant Guincum and then either select Storm Salute from the emote list, or input the /gcsalute text command.

First Flame Lieutenant Aubrey has assigned you a mission of utmost import. The thaumaturges of Arrzaneth Ossuary claim that the primal Ifrit is the culprit behind the recent changes exhibited by the lesser moon Dalamud. In order to substantiate this theory, you have been tasked with vanquishing the Lord of the Inferno himself. As luck would have it, a native of Sharlayan said to hold the secret to defeating primals is sojourning in Gridania at present. Make your way to Apkallus Falls in Gridania and seek the counsel of the man in question, an elderly Elezen named Louisoix.[@CR][@CR]※ Only parties consisting of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] Disciples of War or Magic level [@VALUE(25)] or higher will be allowed to battle the primal Ifrit.[@CR]※ All party members must have either completed one of the three “It Kills with Fire” quests or fulfilled the quest requirements for entering the battlefield.[@CR]※ Winning the battle with a party of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] fully enlisted members of the Immortal Flames will earn you greater rewards.; You have met and spoken with Louisoix at Apkallus Falls and learned that he presides over a fellowship called the Circle of Knowing. According to the wizened Elezen, the primals are draining the land of aether. They must be vanquished, lest the power of the crystals be exhausted and Eorzea reduced to a barren wasteland. For the first step, Louisoix requires that you put down the six mighty beasts identified below, and obtain the echo crystals they yield. More will be revealed once you have accomplished this task.[@CR][@CR]Eastern La Noscea:[@CR]Barometz, northwest of Camp Bloodshore (wind).[@CR]Slippery Sykes, southeast of Camp Bloodshore (water).[@CR][@CR]Western Thanalan:[@CR]The nest commander, northwest of Camp Horizon (earth).[@CR]Pyrausta, west of Camp Horizon (lightning).[@CR][@CR]The South Shroud:[@CR]Queen Bolete, southwest of Camp Tranquil (ice).[@CR]The jackanapes, southeast of Camp Tranquil (fire).; You have successfully obtained the six echo crystals, one for each of the elements. Make haste and report back to Louisoix at Apkallus Falls in Gridania.; Employing his magicks, Louisoix has merged the six echo crystals to create [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000420,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000420,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], an object that grants the bearer entry into the Bowl of Embers, Ifrit's sanctuary. However, in order to summon forth the primal, you must first obtain [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000419,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000419,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. The sacred relic is said to be in the possession of the Amalj'aa Voidtongue Ahzabb Chah, who can be found within a cave situated south of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan.

Upon visiting the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah, First Lieutenant Aubrey entrusts you with an important task. Reports indicate that Garleans at Silvertear Falls in Mor Dhona have begun to mobilize their forces. The Free Brigade of the Immortal Flames, led by High Commander Jakys Ryder, has already been dispatched to intercept an imperial troop marching for Thanalan. You have been ordered to travel to the vicinity of Camp Black Brush in central Thanalan and find them. Join your strength to theirs in the fight against the Garleans.; Free Brigade High Commander Ryder has ordered you to travel to a cave located to the northwest of Camp Black Brush and put down any Garleans you encounter. To protect against the new magitek weaponry they are rumored to have, he provides you with an imperial disruptor─an instrument devised by the genius that is the Garlond Ironworks. Use the disruptor to aid you in battle.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to two party members may accompany you.[@CR]※ Remove the enhanced status of any Garleans by using [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000421,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000421,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] High Commander Ryder provided via the [@COLOR(#ff00cc22)][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)]interaction menu[@COLOR($EC)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)].; You have successfully defeated a group of Garlean soldiers. High Commander Ryder wishes to know the true purpose behind such a small group of imperials marching into Thanalan. Find out what the surviving Garlean knows.; The Echo recalls a vision of an encounter between Cid and the White Raven, Nael van Darnus. After a conversation about Dalamud and Meteor, van Darnus attacks Cid, causing the master engineer to fall from the precipice where he stood. Can this truly be the end of the noble Garlond line? Report what you have seen to High Commander Ryder.

Speaking with First Flame Lieutenant Aubrey at the Hall of Flames, you learn that the Syndicate is moving to deal with the imperial plot known as Meteor. As part of the countermeasure, you have been nominated from amongst the ranks of the Immortal Flames to undertake a mission of great import. Take yourself to the Royal Promenade, in front of the royal palace, where you will be furnished with the details of your task.; You meet with Flame General Raubahn Aldynn, who apprises you of the matter discussed at the Syndicate meeting. According to Teledji Adeledji of the Monetarists, the Empire has developed a more powerful juggernaut and may already have unleashed it upon Eorzea. You are required to gauge the strength of this new weapon, that the Immortal Flames might better combat it. Make your way to the area west of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan, and help your comrades to repel the invading imperial force.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Arriving at the scene of battle, your eyes are met with a horrendous sight: the Immortal Flames sent to engage the enemy have been nigh annihilated. It would appear the new-type juggernaut of which the Flame General spoke is responsible for their downfall. Smite the infernal machine and see that no further lives are lost.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); It is revealed that the juggernaut you destroyed is but a diversion─the main imperial force means to attack the ferry docks in western Thanalan. Make all haste there before the unthinkable happens.

Before Apkallus Falls, Archon Louisoix of the Circle of Knowing has asked you to investigate the cause of the unnaturally strong winds buffeting the Gridanian hamlet of Quarrymill. He fears it may be the work of none other than Garuda, the savage primal whom the Ixal are wont to summon. Travel to Quarrymill in the South Shroud, and discover whence these fell winds blow.[@CR][@CR]※ Only parties consisting of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] to [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] Disciples of War or Magic level [@VALUE(40)] or higher will be permitted to battle the primal Garuda.[@CR]※ All party members must have either completed one of the three “In for Garuda Wakening” quests or fulfilled the quest requirements for entering the battlefield.[@CR]※ Winning the battle with a party composed only of fully enlisted members of the Immortal Flames will earn you greater rewards.; You discovered the source of the winds buffeting Quarrymill to be a being with the traits of both bird and man. Could this be the primal Garuda? Hasten back to Gridania and report all that you have seen to Louisoix.; Louisoix confirms that the being you witnessed assailing Quarrymill was indeed Garuda. He then constructs for you [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000432,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000432,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] from [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000431,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000431,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you obtained at the scene. With it in your possession, he claims that you will be able to use a beastman aetheryte found in a cave in the northeastern part of Feathergorge to reach the Howling Eye. Having made the necessary preparations, sally forth and defeat Garuda.[@CR][@CR]※ Only parties consisting of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] to [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] Disciples of War or Magic level [@VALUE(40)] or higher will be permitted to battle the primal Garuda.[@CR]※ All party members must have either completed one of the three “In for Garuda Wakening” quests or fulfilled the quest requirements for entering the battlefield.[@CR]※ Winning the battle with a party composed only of fully enlisted members of the Immortal Flames will earn you greater rewards.[@CR]※ The allotted time for the battle is [@VALUE(30)] minutes (Earth time).[@CR]※ A waiting time applies between challenges, and you will not be permitted to return to the area immediately. (View the Timers tab located under Attributes in the [@COLOR(#ff00cc22)][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)]main menu[@COLOR($EC)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)] for more information.); You have achieved victory in battle over the wind primal Garuda. Tragically, however, the power of the crystals you wrested from her grasp was quickly claimed by Dalamud. Nael van Darnus, legatus of the Empire's VIIth Legion, tells you that the more adventurers struggle against Garlemald, the more power shall find its way to the red moon of Allag. Return to Louisoix and tell him all that has transpired.

First Flame Lieutenant Aubrey informs you that the Garleans have established a new stronghold in Mor Dhona, a stone's throw from the Gridanian border. In the midst of Raubahn's struggles with manpower and resource shortages in this time of war, he has received an urgent plea from Elder Seedseer Kan[@1F]E[@1F]Senna, requesting his support in reforging the Eorzean Alliance. As the Flame General's emissary, travel to the Lotus Stand in Gridania, by way of the clearing before Stillglade Fane, and there hear the terms Kan[@1F]E[@1F]Senna proposes.; You find Master Cid Garlond at the Lotus Stand. Perhaps he might have some information valuable to the fate of the Eorzean Alliance. Speak to him and find out.; Cid tells you that the imperial stronghold in Mor Dhona is called Castrum Novum. He goes on to say that it is the likely location of the Garleans' lunar transmitter─the device designed to control the red moon, Dalamud. Though more information is needed, he claims the united forces of the Eorzean Alliance will be necessary to obtain it. Speak to the Elder Seedseer, Kan[@1F]E[@1F]Senna, to hear what she proposes.; You have listened to the words of Kan[@1F]E[@1F]Senna at the Lotus Stand. Prospects are grim for Gridania, as they are not like to withstand the brunt of the Garlean offensive for much longer. Should the forest nation fall, the Empire will no doubt turn its wrath next upon Ul'dah and Limsa Lominsa, both of which stand alone. The Elder Seedseer has asked you to convince Flame General Raubahn to commit to the remaking of the Eorzean Alliance. It seems Cid has something he wishes to impart to you. Speak with him once more.

Arriving at Mor Dhona, you receive new orders from Flame Commander Jakys Ryder. With the Eorzean Alliance reforged, the three Grand Companies are making ready to launch a joint offensive against the Empire. Leading a small contingent, your mission is to infiltrate the imperial stronghold Castrum Novum, and destroy the lunar transmitter housed therein. Serpent Commander Vevina Yarborough will furnish you with additional information regarding your objective.[@CR][@CR]※ Only parties consisting of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] to [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] Disciples of War or Magic level [@VALUE(45)] or above will be permitted to attempt this mission.; Serpent Commander Vevina Yarborough has briefed you regarding the finer points of the mission. Upon seeing to your preparations, penetrate Castrum Novum's defenses and lay the lunar transmitter to waste.[@CR][@CR]※ Only parties consisting of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] to [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] Disciples of War or Magic level [@VALUE(45)] or above will be permitted to attempt this mission.[@CR]※ All party members must have fulfilled the entry requirements for one of the three “United We Stand” quests.[@CR]※ Completing the objective with a party containing representatives from all three Grand Companies will earn you greater rewards.[@CR]※ The allotted time for destroying the lunar transmitter is [@VALUE(30)] minutes (Earth time).[@CR]※ A waiting time applies between attempts, and you will not be permitted to return to the area immediately. (View the Timers tab located under Attributes in the [@COLOR(#ff00cc22)][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)]main menu[@COLOR($EC)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)] for more information.); Winning your way to the heart of Castrum Novum, you succeed in destroying the lunar transmitter, whereupon Legatus Nael van Darnus of the VIIth Legion emerges. Clearly agitated, the man speaks ominous words before fleeing the scene. From what little sense you can make of his ravings, the White Raven may yet possess the means to summon Dalamud to Eorzea. Deliver these grim tidings to Flame General Raubahn Aldynn and Cid, who await at the Fragrant Chamber in Ul'dah.; In the Fragrant Chamber, the Flame General listens intently as you recount all that transpired at Castrum Novum. Your tale told, Raubahn pledges to spare no resources in the hunt for Nael van Darnus, and asks that you cooperate with Cid Garlond and Louisoix in any way they see fit. For your show of valor, a reward has been prepared, which can be collected from Flame Marshal Roaille.

At the Hall of Flames, Flame Lieutenant Aubrey informs you that the Eorzean Alliance has successfully tracked down Nael van Darnus. An emergency council will convene at the Lotus Stand in Gridania to deliberate a course of action. You have been ordered to join Flame General Raubahn for the proceedings.; At the Lotus Stand, you learn that Nael van Darnus has fled southeast of Camp Glory in Coerthas, to a place where the Allagan civilization once flourished. The Flame General bids you go to the area in question, whereupon you are to confirm the White Raven's presence and survey the surroundings.[@CR][@CR]※ Only parties consisting of [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] to [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] Disciples of War or Magic with a level of [@VALUE(45)] or above will be permitted to attempt this mission.; Upon arriving at your destination, southeast of Camp Glory, your eyes are met with a disquieting spectacle: an intense beam of light is being sent skywards to Dalamud from a floating mass of land. As if in answer, the red moon spews forth endless cascades of fiery boulders. You are past certain that Nael van Darnus is responsible for this ominous phenomenon. Deliver these tidings to the Flame General, who awaits you at the Lotus Stand in Gridania.; Back at the Lotus Stand, Flame General Raubahn entrusts you with a mission of great import: you are to lead an assault on the floating isle and slay Nael van Darnus. Cid Garlond should be able to assist you in landing a contingent there.

Lefchild tells you of the demand made by the Immortal Flames that Eshtaime's Lapidaries realign its philosophy with the war effort. For their part, the goldsmiths are designing a new accessory to issue to the Flames, but are undecided on which of two materials to use─[@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000404,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000404,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] or [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000405,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000405,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Though both are procured from coblyns, the latter is a much more magnificent stone thought to be obtainable only from a rare type of mutated coblyn. Lefchild asks that you travel to the mesas east of Camp Horizon in Thanalan, and there slay thirty coblyns in an attempt to acquire one of these elusive stones. Use the [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000406,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000406,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] Lefchild has provided to lure the beasts to you.; You were able to prize [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000405,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000405,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] from the eye socket of a dead coblyn. Return to Eshtaime's Lapidaries and deliver it to Lefchild.; Lefchild tells you of the demand made by the Immortal Flames that Eshtaime's Lapidaries realign its philosophy with the war effort. For their part, the goldsmiths are designing a new accessory to issue to the Flames, but are undecided on which of two materials to use─[@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000404,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000404,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] or [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000405,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000405,2,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Though both are procured from coblyns, the latter is a much more magnificent stone thought to be obtainable only from a rare type of mutated coblyn. Lefchild asks that you travel to the mesas east of Camp Horizon in Thanalan, and there slay thirty coblyns in an attempt to acquire one of these elusive stones.

Galeren of the Coliseum informs you of the animosity that exists between the Ul'dahns and the Ala Mhigans of the Immortal Flames. He goes on to tell you that the Ul'dahn members of a newly formed force known as the Beastcleavers have marched forth from the city without disclosing the details of their mission to their Ala Mhigan comrades. Hurry to Pearl Lane, and pass on the information to one Sergeant Cotter.; After making the destination of the Beastcleavers known to Sergeant Cotter, he informs you that the path they are taking is infested with ferocious beasts. Hurry to the northeast of Camp Drybone, and warn the Ul'dahns of the dangers awaiting them.; Upon arriving in the area to the northeast of Camp Drybone, you are promptly attacked by the ravenous beasts of which Sergeant Cotter spoke. Pass his warning on to the Ul'dahn Beastcleavers, who arrived on the scene shortly thereafter.; After hearing Sergeant Cotter's warning, the Ul'dahn Beastcleavers have decided to return to Ul'dah and rethink the route of their march. Visit Galeren at the Coliseum once more, and report all that has happened.

Speaking with Cahernaut of Sunsilk Tapestries, you learn that the weaver has been commissioned by the Immortal Flames to set up a traveling theater company for the purpose of lifting troop morale on the front lines. Being unfamiliar with war, however, the man is unsure how best to undertake the task. Cahernaut requests that you go and ascertain the situation at the mesa that rises northeast of Nophica's Wells, that he might gain some insight into the mind of a soldier.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to two party members may accompany you.; You are set upon by Garlean forces upon arriving at the mesa. Take yourself back to Sunsilk Tapestries in Ul'dah and report to Cahernaut all that you saw and felt─the knowledge may be of some benefit to his cause.

The alchemist Berthar tells you of a failed attack against the encampment of Zahar'ak in which many men of the Immortal Flames were slain by the Amalj'aa's war drakes. To prevent another such tragedy, he has concocted a poison known as the Tears of Nymeia to kill the drakes, and asks that you mix it in with the meat used to feed them. Speak to Jandonaut at Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan to learn where the Amalj'aa keep the fodder for their drakes.; Jandonaut informs you of three places in Zahar'ak where what could only be feed for the drakes is kept─two near the armored vehicles close to the camp's entrance, and another near the structures beyond. Visit each of the three, and mix the Tears of Nymeia in with whatever foulness you find.; You succeeded in lacing all three piles of drake feed with the deadly Tears of Nymeia. Return to Camp Broken Water and speak to Jandonaut once more.

You learn from I'paghlo that the Platinum Mirage has been recouping outstanding loans by sending defaulters to join the Free Brigade, the Immortal Flames unit formed of adventurers. Alas, an alarming number of the defaulters have been losing their lives while in service to the brigade. High Commander Ryder, the brigade leader, is suspected to be behind the deaths, and your task is to obtain proof of this. Take yourself to the mesa that rises south of Mythril Pit No. 8 in eastern Thanalan, and observe the Free Brigade as they go through their drills.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to two party members may accompany you.; You arrive at the mesa to find High Commander Ryder by himself. Could the man truly be putting his underlings to the sword? For want of a better way to uncover the truth, you must confront and question the high commander.; You learn from I'paghlo that the Platinum Mirage has been recouping outstanding loans by sending defaulters to join the Free Brigade, the Immortal Flames unit formed of adventurers. Alas, an alarming number of the defaulters have been losing their lives while in service to the brigade. High Commander Ryder, the brigade leader, is suspected to be behind the deaths, and your task is to obtain proof of this. Take yourself to the mesa that rises south of Mythril Pit No. 8 in eastern Thanalan, and observe the Free Brigade as they go through their drills.

At the Hall of Flames, First Lieutenant Aubrey tells you of an important mission aimed at crippling the Amalj'aa, who mean to take advantage of Ul'dah's preoccupation with the Empire by mounting an opportunistic offensive. After careful surveillance, the Immortal Flames have devised a plan to deprive the lizardmen of the means to make war by striking their supply lines. You are to travel to the Amalj'aa altar in eastern Thanalan and find First Commander Ashdale, who will have orders for you.; First Commander Ashdale has laid out the details of the mission. His unit will ambush the Amalj'aa supply convoy that is scheduled to arrive at any moment. To divert attention and incite chaos, you have been ordered to storm the nearby altar. Kill as many Amalj'aa as you are able.[@CR][@CR]※ No party members may accompany you.[@CR]※ Slay Amalj'aa pennonciers, pennoncier captains, and high divinators at the Amalj'aa altar until you amass 1000 War Merit.[@CR]※ This duty has a time limit of [@VALUE(30)] minutes (Earth time).[@CR]※ All amassed War Merit will be lost should you be KO'd, run out of time, or abandon the duty.; You were able to slay enough Amalj'aa to create an adequate diversion. Report back to First Commander Ashdale on the outskirts of the Amalj'aa altar.; Your diversion allowed First Commander Ashdale's unit to succeed in their attack on the supply convoy, and thus deal a crippling blow to the military might of the Amalj'aa. Return to the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah, and take word of your victory to First Lieutenant Aubrey.

quest_name: Mess with the Goat, Get the Horns
english_samples: First Lieutenant Aubrey has handed down orders from the Immortal Flames. You are to travel to the southeast of Camp Horizon, and further southeast still of Nophica's Wells. There you must put down a beast known as the elder mosshorn, which reports claim has been terrorizing the region and attacking alliance troops.[@CR][@CR]※ The elder mosshorn appears only during daylight hours (Eorzea time).; You have slain the elder mosshorn, bringing its rampage to an end. Return to the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah and report your doings to First Lieutenant Aubrey.; The Immortal Flames have recognized your ability to lead, and promoted you to the commission of officer. Accept the post and swear yourself anew by saluting First Lieutenant Aubrey.[@CR][@CR]※ Target First Lieutenant Aubrey and then either select Flame Salute from the emote list, or input the /gcsalute text command.

Yayake of Arrzaneth Ossuary has asked you to ascertain the truth of a prophecy being spoken by one Ququruka, a prisoner who claims to hear the voice of Nald'thal. The prophecy tells that an adventurer bearing the name of [@STRING($EB(1))] will slay the guano gnats of western Thanalan, and thereby obtain the legendary [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000556,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000556,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Travel north of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan, and there kill guano gnats near the entrance to the Copperbell Mines to see if there truly is such a gem to be had.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); After slaying several guano gnats, an Amalj'aa named Kazagg Chah appeared and presented you with the Gem of Shatotto. Return to Arrzaneth Ossuary and speak to Yayake.; ※ The next black mage quest will be available from Lalai upon reaching level 35.

At Milvaneth Sacrarium, Lalai has imparted to you the next prophecy foretold by Ququruka. When a new light shines from the black mage's testimony that you carry, you are to obtain the key to reseal the Voidgate. To fulfill this prophecy, you must travel west of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan. Once there, find and slay the beast known as Daddy Longlegs.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next black mage quest will be available from Lalai upon reaching level 40.

Lalai has handed down yet another prophecy from her Master. You are to travel west of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan, to a cave not found on any map. In its depths, you must locate an Amalj'aa named Kazagg Chah. Show him the testimony you carry, and gain his allegiance.; West of Camp Horizon, you find the same Amalj'aa who presented you with the Gem of Shatotto. Known as Kazagg Chah, he claims that a prophecy spoken by his great-grandfather led him to this land to see you undertake a trial that would lead to your awakening. As part of this trial, you are to travel south of Camp Bald Knoll in western La Noscea and there slay the beast known as Whitetalon. Kazagg Chah warns that she is a cautious foe, and will first set her minions upon you. Prepare yourself for a memorable battle.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have succeeded in defeating Whitetalon. Return to Kazagg Chah in western Thanalan and tell him of your accomplishment.; ※ The next black mage quest will be available from Dozol Meloc upon reaching level 45.

The Ixal Dozol Meloc tells you that the Gloom emanating from the Voidgate is reacting to the power that has awoken within you. According to him, an ancient black magic that will aid you lies hidden in the Black Shroud, where mages of old sealed it within a stela. Travel to the West Shroud and search for this stela to the northwest of Turning Leaf.; ※ The next black mage quest is now available from Da Za.

Da Za tells you that he set out from his kobold homeland of O'Ghomoro to pursue the same legend recounted by Kazagg Chah and Dozol Meloc. He holds a stone tablet passed down to him from his ancestor, Da Gu. Upon showing it to you, the light from your Gem of Shatotto reveals writing carved into its surface indicating that closing the Voidgate requires certain [@1A(1)]garb[@1A(0)]. To complete your next task as a mage of the black, travel to the first four locations named and seek out this garb.[@CR]- The Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- Dusk Vigil, north of Camp Riversmeet in the Coerthas western highlands.[@CR]- A cave west of Camp Brittlebark in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- A cave south of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.; ※ The next black mage quest will be available from Da Za upon reaching level 50.

The kobold Da Za returned to his home to inquire after the mysterious [@1A(1)]Solace of the Gods[@1A(0)]. Though he was unable to learn its location, he did learn that his ancestor Da Gu set out in search of it one hundred years ago. Could he too have been searching for the artifacts of the black mage? Go and speak to Dozol Meloc to see if he has uncovered anything new.; Dozol Meloc tells you that his great-grandmother left her home at the same time as Da Za's ancestor, one hundred years ago. Is it possible that some connection exists between the two? Speak with Kazagg Chah to see if he is able to shed light on any of this.; Kazagg Chah too had an ancestor who was never heard from again after disappearing one hundred years ago. Among his last writings, the following message was found. “The true power of destruction will be awoken in that most sacred of places.” After speaking with Kazagg Chah, you receive a timely linkpearl call from Ququruka. Contact him via linkpearl, and hear what he has to say.; At the Milvaneth Sacrarium, Lalai debunks her former Master, telling you of a heinous crime he committed one hundred years ago. It seems Ququruka conspired with the beast tribes to create a monster, known as Barbatos, to destroy all of Eorzea. The black magic spoken of in the Ququruka's “prophecy” is not the key to sealing the Voidgate, but rather the key to opening it, unleashing Barbatos upon the realm. Hurry to Nald's Reflection, west of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan, and put an end to Ququruka's evil scheme.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

quest_name: A Song of Bards and Bowmen
english_samples: At the Quiver's Hold, Georjeaux informs you that the legendary archer-turned-bard, Jehantel the Godsbow, has recently returned to the Twelveswood. Aspiring to transcendent mastery of the bow, several members of the Gods' Quiver have presented themselves as pupils to the legend. Alas, all have returned disappointed, as Jehantel offers only to teach poetry and verse. If you would learn from the man nonetheless, make your way north of Camp Tranquil, where he is said to have made his camp.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Having exchanged pleasantries with Jehantel, you astonish the kindly old bard by taking him up on his offer to teach you poetry and verse. He excitedly instructs you to present yourself to a moogle named Pukno Poki, who resides within a cave situated east of Camp Tranquil.; Speaking with Pukno Poki, the moogle prevails upon you to recover a stolen charm that was meant for Jehantel. The thief, a Qiqirn shirrer, was last seen fleeing to the east of Camp Tranquil.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have put down the Qiqirn shirrer and reclaimed Pukno Poki's stolen charm. See that the object is delivered to Jehantel, who awaits north of Camp Tranquil.

You listen in bewilderment as Jehantel relates to you the origin of the bardic tradition. Apparently, bards were born when archers burst into song in order to cope with the stresses of battle. To drive the lesson home, Jehantel requires that you confront a lone jackal known as Bardi, who prowls the Nanawa Mines north of Ul'dah. In facing this foe in mortal combat and understanding what drives it, a new melody will surely reveal itself to you.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 40.

You listen intently as Jehantel reveals that common bards also owe their existence to archers. According to him, the coming of peacetime left soldiers jobless, and many of those who had once bent the bow took to strumming the harp. Jehantel then offers to perform for you the Ballad of the Vainglorious Fool, but only if you first convince him that the lesson will not be lost upon you. Make your way to the Central Shroud and defeat the boar called Phaia, thereby proving your readiness.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 45.

Jehantel sings for you the Ballad of the Vainglorious Fool, which depicts the events of the Massacre of Griffin Crossing, where an entire regiment of the Gods' Quiver was annihilated by the Ixal. Desiring that you demonstrate the fruits of your learning with bow in hand, Jehantel asks that you escort him to a place north of Hyrstmill.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); En route to your destination, Jehantel spots an Ixali van, and a battle ensues. The erstwhile archer swiftly primes his bow, but inexplicably cannot bring himself to fire. You have no choice but to repel the enemy without his aid.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); ※ The next bard quest is now available from Jehantel.

Jehantel declares you worthy of the choral attire, which he received from Pukno Poki when first they met in the Twelveswood. Having lost the will to live, however, Jehantel scattered the garments across the land, going to great pains to ensure that he would never see them again. The choral attire is yours, if you can but brave the perils of the following locations and retrieve them:[@CR]- Cutter's Cry, west of Camp Bluefog in northern Thanalan.[@CR]- Zahar'ak, east of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- A cave south of Camp Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.; ※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 50.

After long years, Jehantel has finally mustered the courage to confront his inner demons, and bids you accompany him on a pilgrimage to the scene of his regiment's demise. Your destination is where the Griffin Crossing meets the central highlands of Coerthas. Once there, Jehantel intends to honor his fallen comrades with song, that their tormented souls might be laid to rest.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Just as you arrive at your destination, an Ixali war band appears. After a fierce struggle, your party emerges victorious. With the area now secure, Jehantel may sing to his heart's content.

Haurtefert of the Wood Wailers has prevailed upon you to assist his Ishgardian acquaintance, a knight named Ser Alberic, in a matter of some sensitivity. The details of your task will be revealed when you meet the man at the Gates of Judgement, in the central highlands of Coerthas.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Upon meeting Ser Alberic, you learn that an Ishgardian relic of immeasurable worth called the Eye has been stolen. The thief, a dragoon named Estinien, is believed to have concealed himself in the vicinity of Camp Nine Ivies, in the East Shroud. Your task is to cull the fell creatures said to inhabit the area, that the search effort might proceed unhampered.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); In the midst of the culling, you find yourself confronted by a dragoon clad all in black. Just when it seemed that steel must clash, you become bathed in a mysterious light, an event which prompts your opponent's withdrawal. Who is the knight, and what is true nature of the light? Perhaps Ser Alberic can offer you some answers...; ※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 35.

Ser Alberic relates to you the story of Haldrath, the first Azure Dragoon, who prized out the eye of the great wyrm Nidhogg a thousand years ago. With an unwavering sense of justice as his aegis, he prevailed over the power of the dragon and made it his own. Since that time, the Azure Dragoon has been the light of hope for Ishgard, the paragon of all dragoons. In order to wake the dragon within, Ser Alberic requires that you slay a monster called the bomb baron, who has grown agitated in the wake of a dragon attack. The creature can be found in Cassiopeia Hollow, east of Camp Bloodshore in eastern La Noscea.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 40.

Ser Alberic recounts to you events of fifteen years past, when the great wyrm Nidhogg last awakened. As the Azure Dragoon, he met the beast in battle. While he succeeded in repelling it, he sustained grievous injuries that led to the loss of his powers. It was then that Ser Alberic met the young Estinien, who had been orphaned in the destruction. Now, the dragons are stirring once more, roused by the disturbance surrounding the Eye. Yet another dragon attack has occurred near Millers' Glade in the eastern lowlands of Coerthas, and a young dragoon was slain. Drawn by the scent of death, a creature named Spitfire has taken to desecrating his final resting place. Ser Alberic bids you slay the creature, that your comrade might know true peace.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 45.

Ser Alberic has received a message from Estinien, the dragoon who made off with the Eye. The fugitive would trade words with you, and bids you meet him in the foothills southwest of Skyfire Locks. Take yourself to the rendezvous point, that you might learn of Estinien's intentions.; Estinien reveals that he took the Eye in order to divert Nidhogg's attention from Ishgard. The great wyrm stirs once more, and Estinien means to avenge his family and village by slaying it. Bidding you join your strength to his, he instructs you to acquire the drachen mail, a suit of armor forged of the blood of living dragons. The pieces have been sealed away at the following locations:[@CR]- The Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- The cave north of Camp Brittlebark in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- The U'Ghamaro Mines, northeast of Camp Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.[@CR]- The cave north of Camp Bluefog in northern Thanalan.; ※ The next dragoon quest is now available from Alberic.

Ser Alberic confesses that he willingly relinquished the power of the dragon, fearing that it would corrupt him. Giving you stern warning never to forget whence comes your power, he bids you prove yourself worthy to champion the cause to which your lance is sworn. Take yourself to the western highlands of Coerthas, to an area south of Camp Riversmeet for which the camp is named. Once there, you are to seek out and slay the drake known as Stollenwurm.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.; ※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 50.

An urgent message has arrived from Estinien. Nidhogg is on the move, and your fellow Azure Dragoon bids you meet him at Griffin Crossing for the encounter. The southbound highroad will take you to the rendezvous point.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); In an unexpected turn of events, Estinien makes known the rancor he harbors towards Ser Alberic for failing to protect his village fifteen years ago. A fierce struggle breaks out between the two Azure Dragoons, with you emerging the victor. Desperate, Estinien gives in to the great wyrm's seduction, whereupon a being of darkness manifests and advances upon you. Moments before you are devoured, however, the being inexplicably takes fright and fades into nothingness. Shaken by the experience but otherwise unharmed, Ser Alberic bids you meet him back at the Gates of Judgement.

Gagaruna of the Platinum Mirage has asked you to see to the protection of Professor Erik, an eminent scholar of Eorzean military history. Go and find this learned man at Ul'dah's chocobo stables, and guard his life with yours.; You have learned that Professor Erik means to study Eorzea's ancient battlefields using a revolutionary new method. His survey will begin with one such site closely related to the now centuries-dead nation of Sil'dih. Travel to Mythril Pit T[@1F]8, located to the south of Camp Drybone. There slay the indigenous runagate imps to ensure the Professor's well-being.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); ※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 35.; Gagaruna of the Platinum Mirage has asked you to see to the protection of Professor Erik, an eminent scholar of Eorzean military history. Go and find this learned man at Ul'dah's chocobo stables, and guard his life with yours.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Professor Erik has asked that you aid him in measuring the aether concentrations of ancient battlefields. You are to travel to the area south of Cedarwood in lower La Noscea. There put down the beast known as Gluttonous Gertrude. Only after eliminating the dire threat she poses to the Professor's research can you safely use [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000552,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000552,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] he has provided.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 40.

The Professor is satisfied with the results of the measurements you took, and has requested that you aid him with two further tasks. You are to first collect the aetheriometer kept by Widargelt, after which he asks that you measure the aetherial concentration of the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars. Begin by heading south of Camp Drybone in southern Thanalan to Little Ala Mhigo, and seek out Widargelt.; Widargelt suspiciously informs you that his aether measurements are not yet complete. While waiting for his aetheriometer, see to the Professor's second task. Head to the North Shroud and find the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars, which lie to the north of Emerald Moss. Before safely taking your measurements, you will need to defeat yet another enemy of science and knowing─the Prince of Pestilence.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; You have defeated the Prince of Pestilence near the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars. Now find a suitable location for [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000553,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000553,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and carry out the measurements requested by the Professor.; ※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 45.

Professor Erik is absolutely livid that you and Widargelt took measurements at the same location. After careful consideration of the results, however, he is on the verge of formulating yet another revolutionary new theory. To find the evidence he requires, take measurements in the area northwest of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan─a place where the aether is known to be in a state of great flux. Doing so will almost certainly require you to slay Apep, a basilisk known to inhabit the region.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.; ※ The next monk quest is now available from Widargelt.

Widargelt demands to know what you have told Professor Erik about him. He goes on to share with you knowledge about the monk's garb he is wearing. It seems the garb serves to channel and amplify the power of its wearer's chakras. Travel to the following ancient battlegrounds, and there search for the four artifacts he has hidden as part of your trial.[@CR]- Dzemael Darkhold, southwest of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- The U'Ghamaro Mines, northeast of Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- A cliff overlooking the Sagolii desert, southeast of Ul'dah.; ※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 50.

The release of Professor Erik's theorem has been met with accolades in the scholarly community. All attempts to contact Widargelt and share the good news, however, have failed, nor has Widargelt responded to being hailed via linkpearl. The Professor concludes that he must have set out for Silvertear Falls─the only location where it is thought possible to open the seventh chakra. Hurry to the Falls and put an end to Widargelt's ambitions before disaster strikes.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You arrive at Silvertear Falls only to find you are too late. Widargelt has already opened his seventh chakra, and with his newfound powers summarily annihilated a number of Garlean soldiers. The power flowing through his chakra is too great, however, and he has lost control over it. Defeat him to quell the rampant energy surging through him.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Widargelt explains that he sought power only to enable him to reclaim Ala Mhigo from the Empire's evil clutches. Already left physically devastated by the opening of his seventh chakra, Professor Erik adds insult to injury by lecturing Widargelt on the laws and ethics of power. Comfort Widargelt by speaking to him and telling him that everything is going to be just fine.

Lulutsu of the Coliseum has given you some interesting news. For the first time in their history, the elite of the Sultansworn are prepared to teach the secret arts of the paladin to outsiders. If you wish to learn these skills, seek out the captain of the Sultansworn elite. His name is Jenlyns, and he can be found near the Royal Promenade, in Ul'dah's Hustings Strip.; You have spoken to Jenlyns, captain of the Sultansworn. He is prepared to teach you the paladin skills, but only after you have proven yourself worthy. To that end, he tells you to travel to a way station called the Coffer & Coffin in western Thanalan, and thence head south to face the undead monsters that infest the area.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); As you finish off the last of the monsters, you are approached by a free paladin. He hands you a strange crystal and asks that you give it to Captain Jenlyns. Report back to Jenlyns at his station near the Royal Promenade, in Ul'dah's Hustings Strip.; ※ The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 35.

Jenlyns tells you that the elite of the Sultansworn have lost the respect that their good name once commanded, and the main reason is the theft of the sword Oathkeeper by a traitor. Jenlyns is hoping that your skills in battle will help him recover the sword, which has been passed down through generations of Sultansworn captains. To that end, he pledges to teach you more paladin skills and assigns a new task. You are to find and defeat the alux beast that lurks in the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars of the North Shroud.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 40.

You learn from Jenlyns that the traitor who stole the sword Oathkeeper is named Solkzagyl, and that he was a Sultansworn captain for thirty long years. The recovery of the sword will be very difficult, and Jenlyns pledges to teach you more of the paladin arts to prepare you for the fight. In order to properly hone your new skills, Jenlyns commands you to go to lower La Noscea and defeat the giant crab king, Old Six-arms.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 45.

Jenlyns has uncovered archived records that point to a link between Solkzagyl and a faction within the Syndicate known as the Monetarists. While he continues his search for the missing traitor, Jenlyns asks you to recover the four pieces of the gallant armor. They can be found in these locations:[@CR]- Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- Natalan, east of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- A cave north of Camp Brittlebark, in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- A cave northeast of Camp Crimson Bark, in the West Shroud.; ※ The next paladin quest is now available from Jenlyns.

Through intermediaries, Jenlyns has arranged a parley with Solkzagyl in order to negotiate the return of Oathkeeper. However, the meeting could be a trap, and Jenlyns has asked you to accompany him. The parley will be held on high ground in the northeast of Ul'dah.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); When you arrive at the parley, Jenlyns suddenly turns his sword against you and accuses you of being in league with Solkzagyl and the Monetarists. You have no time to explain or persuade him otherwise―if you want to live, your only choice is to fight Jenlyns and his soldiers.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 50.

Jenlyns has learned that he was an unwitting dupe of the Monetarists. But although his captaincy is a sham, he will use what power he has to strike back at the cabal. For the showdown, he has chosen an area southeast of Camp Bluefog, but he commands you to stay away and find a safe haven. What you do next is up to you and your conscience.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); When you arrive at the battleground that Jenlyns has chosen to launch his campaign against the cabal, you find him and Solkzagyl facing off against the Monetarists' monster cohort. Help them fight off the attackers.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have defeated the monsters sent by the Monetarists. Solkzagyl leaves the Sultansworn in Jenlyns's hands and returns to his paladin's journey. Return to Ul'dah, find Jenlyns at his station near the Royal Promenade in the Hustings Strip, and talk to him once more.

quest_name: Pride and Duty (Will Take You from the Mountain)
english_samples: After agreeing to report back to him anything you learn, gentlemanly bastard Neale has given you information regarding the whereabouts of a mysterious new member of the Company of Heroes. The man's name is Curious Gorge and rumor has it that he is holed up in a cave southeast of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan. It is said that he has journeyed from the Farreach and may be skilled in the ancient techniques of the legendary mountain warriors.; After warning you not to mock his unique name─on pain of decapitation─Curious Gorge tells you of his village, their art, and his reasons for journeying south. He also invites you to train in the ancient ways of the warrior, but only after proving that your will is strong enough to endure the challenge by slaying the antling workers which make their nest to the north of Curious Gorge's cave.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have slain the antling workers. Now return to Curious Gorge's cave and inform the Hellsguard of your victory.; ※ The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 35.

Deciphering the ancient chronicles is proving to be difficult for Curious Gorge, but he was able to learn of a legendary set of armor lost when its proud owner cast it from a mountain on Ablathia's Spine. Unfortunately, the remainder of the tale will require more time to translate. In the meantime, your teacher has devised a second exercise which will help temper your will, allowing you to tap the power of your inner beast and slay even the most nimble of foes. Travel to Humblehearth in the Black Shroud and seek out the beastkin known as Sirocco.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; ※ The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 40.

quest_name: Curious Gorge Goes to the Bazaar
english_samples: Curious Gorge has learned from the chronicles that his tribe supposedly fell from grace when the city-states blamed the art of the warrior for the terrible transformation that befell a handful of newly trained soldiers and led them to murder. Not able to accept this fate, Curious Gorge has pledged to prove his tribe's innocence by showing the realm the power and skill of a true warrior─starting with a Company of Heroes mission to slay a flock of carnivorous condors that nests to the north of the Silver Bazaar.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have slain the condors in the north. Travel to the east gate of the Silver Bazaar to complete the two-pronged attack devised by Curious Gorge.; As you arrive in the Silver Bazaar, you bear witness to utter pandemonium as Curious Gorge's frenzied slaughter of the canyon condors comes to a close. Horrified by what they have just seen, the hamlet's residents lambaste their savior, calling him a monster. Unable to fully comprehend what has happened, Curious Gorge flees from the scene. Perhaps you should pay him a visit.; The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 45.

At long last, Curious Gorge has discovered the location of his ancestor's legendary armor. Apparently, each of the five pieces that make up the set has been buried at the site of a great battle. He has marked your map with four of the locations, choosing to retrieve the final piece himself. The locations are as follows:[@CR]- Cutter's Cry in northern Thanalan.[@CR]- Natalan in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- Turning Leaf in the West Shroud.[@CR]- Craneperch Tower in lower La Noscea.; The next warrior quest from Curious Gorge is now available.

When unable to channel the power of the legendary cuirass, Curious Gorge comes to the conclusion that his ancestors are waiting for him to prove his strength before allowing him access to their secrets. To do this, he proposes a challenge based on a passage from the chronicles that tells of a final technique only passed down to those warriors who have slain the most monstrous of beasts. In short, whoever fells Audhumbla from the caves of Iron Lake and earns the technique first will lay claim to all five pieces of the legendary armor.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.; The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 50.

Before settling the issue regarding who is to receive the complete set of ancient armor, Curious Gorge has asked you to accompany him once again to the Silver Bazaar where it is said a terrible creature is attacking the hamlet's citizens. He believes this is an opportune moment to prove to the realm that the art of the warrior is not one to be feared.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Upon arriving in the Silver Bazaar, you find that Curious Gorge is already engaged in battle with the creature...which appears to be a man outfitted in the same warrior's garb as your friend. You later learn that this man is, in fact, Curious Gorge's missing brother, Broken Mountain, and that he has succumbed to his inner beast and its insatiable bloodlust. In his attempt to free his brother from the beast's tightening grip, Curious Gorge, too, loses himself to the rage, and after toppling his brother, sets his frenzied gaze on you![@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have helped Curious Gorge regain control of his inner beast. Now speak with him once more at the Silver Bazaar to ensure that he is truly sound of mind.

Speaking with Soileine of Stillglade Fane, you learn that thieves have been making off with items left at Lifemend Stump. Before the Conjurers' Guild could act, however, Seedseer Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna took matters into her own hands and ventured into the Twelveswood. It is believed that she is presently within a cave situated beneath a lake west of Camp Emerald Moss. Soileine bids you make your way there to ascertain the Seedseer's present condition.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Seedseer Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna tells you that the enchanted staff [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000551,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000551,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], a priceless Gridanian relic, was among the items stolen from Lifemend Stump. The thieves are believed to be a family of vilekin, a diremite straggler and her miteling brood, who are ensconced within the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars, north of Camp Emerald Moss. Your task is to put down the creatures and reclaim [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000551,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000551,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended); The vilekin lie slain, and [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000551,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000551,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] is now safely in your hands. Hasten back to the lakeside cave and present the staff to Raya[@1F]O.; ※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 35.

You return to the cave to find Raya[@1F]O in conversation with Oha[@1F]Sok. The Seedseer attempts to justify the need for nations to shore up their military might, but the elemental is unconvinced and takes her leave. Regaining her composure, Raya[@1F]O relays to you Twin Adder-sourced intelligence concerning a sheep that has turned feral southwest of Camp Glory. The creature, known to the locals as Downy Dunstan, is suspected to be acting under elemental influence. Raya[@1F]O requires that you subdue Downy Dunstan using white magic.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; You have subdued Downy Dunstan. Hasten back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.; Hearing of your mission's success, Raya[@1F]O contacts you by linkpearl and orders you to hasten back to the cave.; ※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 40.

According to Raya[@1F]O, the elementals have begun to raise their voices in anger. She vows to do all in her power to quell their rage, and bids you assist her. You are told of Cactuar Jack, another creature suspected to have grown savage due to elemental influence. You must subdue the cactuar, who can be found east of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.; You have subdued Cactuar Jack. Hasten back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.; ※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 45.

Raya[@1F]O edifies you regarding the Fifth Astral Era, which ended when a great deluge came and cleansed the land of man's wickedness. Concerned that history may be about to repeat itself, the Seedseer is eager to do whatever she can to help set the world to rights. Reports have arrived that a bandit and his minions have taken to preying upon hapless travelers at the land bridge south of Camp Bearded Rock. Raya[@1F]O strongly suspects that they act under elemental influence, and bids you liberate the hapless souls.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); You have triumphed over the bandits and freed them from their enthrallment. Yet all is not well. Disheartened by mankind's readiness to hurt one another, Oha[@1F]Sak give you an ominous warning before taking her leave. Hasten back to the cave and tell Raya[@1F]O all that has transpired.; ※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 45.

Raya[@1F]O believes that Oha[@1F]Sok has been observing the children of the Sixth Astral Era, suggesting that she has yet to give up on mankind. Nevertheless, the presence of wrath incarnate alone is enough to impel the elementals to sustain their keening indefinitely, which will inevitably lead to catastrophe. In order to restore the enraged elementals to calm, Raya[@1F]O bids you acquire the garb of succor, the legendary artifacts worn by the white mages of old. Raya[@1F]O has marked the whereabouts of four pieces on your map.[@CR]- Dzemael Darkhold, southwest of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- Zahar'ak, east of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- Tiger Helm Island, southeast of Camp Bloodshore in eastern La Noscea.; Four pieces of the garb of succor are now in your possession. Make your way back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.; ※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 50.

Oha[@1F]Sok's return to the Twelveswood has prompted the elementals to intensify their keening; it is only a matter of time before catastrophe is unleashed upon Eorzea. Even though the fifth and final artifact eludes you still, you must act now lest the unthinkable come to pass. Raya[@1F]O senses the keening most strongly southwest of Camp Bentbranch, and bids you quell the elementals there.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended); Just when all seems lost, Oha[@1F]Sok arrives to save you from her kindred's wrath. In a touching turn of events, the elemental of nihility then offers to remain by your side, transforming into the final artifact of succor. Hasten back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.

You are guided through the forest by a strange, soothing voice. Suddenly, you see a trail of smoke in the skies overhead as an airship plummets to the ground. You hurry in the direction of the wreckage and come across two bodies lying unconscious amid a clearing. Approach them and attempt to bring them back to their senses.; The Lalafell and Hyur you found in the forest are not injured, but a hungry pack of feral wolves has closed in around them─and you! Defeat the beasts and secure your lives!; While fighting off the hungry wolves which threatened you, a raging treant appeared to make your situation even more dire. Luckily, the power of the moogles saved you from its clutches just in time. A strange wizard of the wood and a unit of masked warriors appeared and have seen you safely to Gridania. But where should you go from here? Speak to the members of your escort to learn more.

You have found your way to the Adventurers' Guild in Gridania, located at the luxurious Carline Canopy. Miounne, or Mother Miounne, as she is known, has a heart of gold, and sees to it adventurers in the region never lack for tasks. Speak to other adventurers in the area to learn what you can of Gridania, and then pay Mother Miounne another visit.; Miounne has suggested that you travel to Camp Bentbranch in the Black Shroud and attune yourself to the aetheryte located there. Camp Bentbranch is the closest of the camps to the city within the Black Shroud, or Twelveswood as it is called by the forestborn. Travel east out of the Adventurers' Guild and venture forth from the city through Blue Badger Gate. Once in the forest, head south, and make use of your map to find the camp.; Upon attuning yourself to the aetheryte at Camp Bentbranch, you are immediately contacted by Miounne via the linkpearl she gave you. She confesses to having smuggled a guildleve amongst your belongings, and leaves the freedom to undertake it or not completely in your hands. Whatever you choose to do, visit Miounne again at the Carline Canopy once you have adventured to your heart's content.; Upon attuning yourself to the aetheryte at Camp Bentbranch, you are immediately contacted by Miounne via the linkpearl she gave you. Whatever you choose to do from here, visit Miounne again at the Carline Canopy once you have adventured to your heart's content.

You wake to the soft sound of singing, yet upon looking around, you see no one resembling a songstress. A blunt greeting by a sour-smelling Roegadyn calling himself Rostnsthal does little to provide you with any insight into your current situation. Perhaps one of the other passengers knows something.; When your exploration of the hold leads you above decks, you find the ship has sailed into the midst of a mighty storm. To make matters worse, a horde of slavering sea beasts has spilled onto the ship and begun to harass her hopelessly outnumbered crew. Join Sthalmann and Y'shtola in battle, and help them to repel the frenzied aurelias.; The storm has retreated, and with it the aurelias. However, several mysteries remain, the biggest being the colossal beast which you witnessed leap forth from the depths and nearly destroy the ship. Now that you have safely arrived in Limsa Lominsa, perhaps it is best to start by gathering information that may shed light on the events that occurred on your journey.

Captain Hob has escorted you to the Drowning Wench, also known as the Adventurers' Guild, and introduced you to her proprietor, Baderon. After speaking with several of the guild's patrons, talk with Baderon once again and see if he has any advice for a fledgling adventurer such as yourself.; Baderon has suggested that you visit Camp Bearded Rock, located just beyond the Zephyr Gate leading out of Limsa Lominsa. Once you have arrived, place your hands upon the aetheryte and attune yourself with the crystal. This will allow for swift travel to the location in the future.; Shortly after attuning with Camp Bearded Rock's aetheryte crystal, you receive a message from Baderon's private linkpearl. It seems he has gifted you with a “guildleve,” granting you access to a simple levequest. Whether you accept the quest or not is up to you. However, Baderon would like to speak with you in person when you reach a lull in your adventures.; Shortly after attuning with Camp Bearded Rock's aetheryte crystal, you receive a message from Baderon's private linkpearl. He requests an audience once you have reached a lull in your adventures.

A mysterious, dreamlike voice rouses you from your slumber aboard a chocobo coach. Coming to your senses, you find that you have arrived in Ul'dah. There you meet a cheerful young girl named Ascilia from the same coach, who is caught up in the excitement of the ongoing festivities. Speak to the people nearby and see if anyone else heard the same strange voice that woke you.; A grand procession is passing on Ul'dah's main road, and all are enjoying the festivities. But an enormous goobbue supposedly made docile by the magic of a thaumaturge breaks loose and wreaks havoc on the city and its inhabitants. Together with Niellefresne and Thancred, subdue the beast and save the innocent bystanders.; You managed to subdue the raging goobbue. Intriguingly, the city's residents do not seem unduly shaken by their brush with death, having already returned to enjoying the festivities. Speak to others around you to discover how an adventurer might go about getting [@IF($E9(4),her,his)] bearings in this town.

You have found the famous Quicksand, the Ul'dahn branch of the Adventurers' Guild, and had the pleasure of meeting its proprietress, Momodi, who caters to the whims of the region's adventurers with the tough love of a mother. Speak to Momodi again to learn of how an adventurer might get [@IF($E9(4),her,his)] start here in the south of Eorzea.; Momodi of the Adventurers' Guild has told you of some of the other guilds to which Ul'dah is home. She has also suggested that [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000089,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000089,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you obtained at the parade may well fetch a hefty sum from the goldsmiths of Eshtaime's Lapidaries. In addition, you have learned that fighting at the Coliseum, home of the sword-wielding gladiators, is another means of earning potentially enormous sums of gil─should you be victorious. Visit these guilds and see what Ul'dah has to offer, using your map should you have need of it.; Momodi of the Quicksand has urged you to venture forth to Camp Black Brush, the closest of Thanalan's camps to the city, and attune yourself to the aetheryte located there. To reach it, leave the Adventurers' Guild by the north exit, and take the west road by way of the Gate of Nald. Any adventurer equipped with a map should have minimal trouble finding it.; Upon attuning to the aetheryte found at Camp Black Brush, Momodi of the Quicksand promptly contacted you via the linkpearl she provided you with earlier. She confessed to unabashedly smuggling a guildleve amongst your belongings, leaving the decision to undertake it or not completely up to you. Whatever you choose to do, return to the Quicksand once you have adventured to your heart's content.

Gridanian culture holds a special place for those to whom the elementals of the forest entrust a task─oft calling them “the beckoned.” But young Khrimm refuses to believe this. Papalymo and Yda have gone to the Oak Atrium in hopes of finding Khrimm and speaking to him. You, too, must visit the Carpenters' Guild to see about the crafting of the mask you are to wear at the purification rites.; Zezekuta of the carpenters has showed you the mask you are to wear in the purification rite, explaining that the woodsin which clings to a soul is transferred to the mask by the power and magic of the dances. He mentioned that an older mask had broken, perhaps due to the woodsin being too great a burden. Your conversation is interrupted by the entrance of a young girl named Fye, who is searching for Khrimm. You still bear a message from the moogle to deliver to Fye. Go to the Acorn Orchard just outside and see that she hears it.; You find Khrimm and Fye speaking to one another in the Acorn Orchard, and overhear talk of Fye's elder brother, Dunstan, and his tragic fate of being turned into a wildling. Fye claims that she is making a new mask for her brother, refusing to give up hope of cleansing him of his woodsin. Khrimm, however, claims to no longer believe in the existence of the elementals, and the conversation ends with his leaving. Speak to Fye, and deliver the moogle's message.
